strings.(어떤 장소보다 조용했던 프뉴마가 시끄러운 분위기다. 아르케가 있던 자리: (Pneuma, usually quieter than anywhere else, is abuzz. A crowd of spirits has gathered where Arche stands.)
strings.아에루라, 무슨 일 있어? 왜 이렇게 정령들이 모여 있는 거야? 카이로스: Aerura, what's happening? Why are all the spirits gathered here? Did Kairos do a somersault or something? He did, then left?
strings.(아에루라의 머리 위로 물음표 기호가 잔뜩 뜬다.): (A host of question marks appears above Aerura's head.)
strings.그거 말고 모르겠다고? 그러면 가서 확인해 보자. 프뉴마에 정령들이 많긴: That's all you know? Then let's go see. There really are a lot of spirits in Pneuma. How many is this...?
strings.(많은 정령들을 비집고 들어가자 두 사람의 모습이 보인다. %s의 얼굴을: (Squeezing through the crowd of spirits, the adventurer finds two familiar figures. The violet eyes they turn toward %s seem especially deep today.)
I did, but how did you get here, Iris...?
strings.제 힘으로는 프뉴마에 접근할 수 없었는데, 엘리시아가 프뉴마와 연결되면서: My power couldn't reach Pneuma before. But now that Elysia is connected to it, I can come here.
Though I still can't approach Elysia itself.
You're the only one who can go to Elysia right now, %s.
It feels as though they want me to face those trials again...
Being allowed into a god's domain means you've been acknowledged.
I'm sorry. I wish I could do more...
Don't say that, Iris. I'm sorry. If only I were stronger...
Neither of you is to blame for the bad things happening in this world.
Thank you for understanding, Arche. But have we...?
strings.어디서 본 적 있나요? 왜 이렇게 낯익죠? 분명 오늘 처음 만난 것 같은: Have we met somewhere? You seem so familiar. I'm sure this is our first meeting...
I wanted to keep it a secret, but in a way, I'm a distant relative of yours...
Oh, that's right. But that isn't a secret, is it?
I wanted to be a woman of mystery. It's a shame you found me out so quickly.
Let's see each other often. I'll come visit.
strings.(이리스가 아르케의 두 손을 잡는다. 아르케가 환하게 웃으며 이리스를 바: (Iris takes both of Arche's hands. Arche looks at her with a radiant smile.)
strings.고마워요. 프뉴마엔 정령 말고는 언제나 혼자였는데, %s 님도 오시고,: Thank you. Apart from the spirits, I was always alone in Pneuma. Now %s visits, and you do too... I'm so happy!
Oh, %s... Right. I came to tell you something. About Hilda and Levi...
strings.엘리시아가 프뉴마와 연결되면서 저는 많은 걸 알게 됐어요. 많은 선택이: When Elysia connected to Pneuma, I learned a great deal. I had many choices to make, and I saw pieces of the future that would unfold from them.
strings.그래서 저는 절 감고 있는 타래를 풀려고 해요. 일단 몇 가지 일을 해결: So I'm trying to unravel the threads wound around me. I've already resolved a few things.
strings.사이암을 어둠 속에서 꺼냈어요. 제 선택을 방해하는 마녀와 마족의 방해가: I brought Siam out of the darkness. Witches and demons tried to interfere with my choice, but fortunately, it worked out.
And I've asked Siam to handle matters concerning Hilda, so don't worry too much. I'll tell you about the other things as soon as they're resolved.
strings.(이리스가 이렇게 이야기했으니까 괜찮겠지….): (If Iris says so, it should be all right...)
strings.레비는 지금 판도라를 찾아 프레이오스 대륙을 여행 중이에요. 판도라가 하: Levi is traveling through Freios in search of Pandora. If what she's doing concerns him, he intends to stop her.
What Pandora is trying to do...
I don't think she'll stop, even if it brings her closer to the night.
Pandora told me not to get involved with the night...
Even she probably didn't realize then how far this would go.
strings.판도라가 레비를 위해 움직이는 이상, 레비도 안전하지 않아요. 밤을 향해: As long as Pandora is acting for Levi's sake, he isn't safe either. Other witches pursuing the night may target him.
Iris... What can I do to help? Tell me...
You've only just had a little rest. I'm sorry to ask you to do something else.
It's all right. It's for you.
Please persuade Levi to stop searching for Pandora and return to Jiendia...
strings.알았어. 그러면 레비는 지금 어디 있는 거야?: All right. Where is he now?
strings.판도라는 어디에 있는지 알 수 없지만, 레비가 어디로 가는지 알게 됐어요: I don't know where Pandora is, but I've learned where Levi is headed.
strings.정령들 말을 들어보니까… 아이사르 강을 따라 가면 보이는 루리아 마을로: According to the spirits... he's going to Luria Village, along the Isar River.
All right. I'll find Levi and try to persuade him.
strings.그동안 제가 힐다를 잘 붙잡고 있을게요. 너무 걱정하지 마요. 제 모험가: I'll keep Hilda safely with me in the meantime. Don't worry too much. I won't let my adventurer be put in danger.
strings.(이리스가 눈인사와 함께 천천히 뒤로 물러난다. 그러자 정령들이 배웅하듯: (Iris offers a gentle nod and slowly steps back. The spirits follow her away, as though seeing her off.)
I suppose she can't stay away for long either.
strings.(이리스를 배웅하던 아르케가 돌아와 %s의 얼굴을 바라본다.): (After seeing Iris off, Arche returns and studies %s's face.)
strings.%s 님, 지금 정말 괜찮으신가요?: %s, are you really all right now?
Yes. Aerura helped me feel better.
strings.사실 이건 비밀인데…. 카이로스하고 크로노스가 중간에 한 번 깨우러 왔었: Actually, this is a secret... Kairos and Chronos came to wake you at one point. They got tired of trying and went home, saying you'd wake when you were ready.
They argued so loudly over waking you, %s, but you still didn't stir. Anyway, I'm glad you're feeling better.
Now I feel a little guilty. Sigh. I'd better go too, Arche.
strings.조심해서 가세요. 그리고 너무 무리하진 마세요. 힘들 때는 도움을 요청하: Travel safely. And don't push yourself too hard. Ask for help when you need it.
strings.(루리아 마을에 가는 길을 모르니 누구에게 물어볼까? 네레이스 관문에 있: (I don't know the way to Luria Village. Who should I ask? I'll try Notos at Nereis Gateway.)
strings.%s 님, 어서 오세요. 허공해 쪽에서 시원한 바람이 불어와서 반가운 손: Welcome, %s. A cool breeze came in from the Void Sea, and I thought it might herald a welcome guest. And here you are, %s.
strings.(노토스가 보고 있던 마법서를 덮고 사람 좋은 미소로 맞이한다.): (Notos closes his spellbook and greets the adventurer with a warm smile.)
strings.안녕하세요, 노토스 님. 그동안 별일 없었나요?: Hello, Notos. Has everything been all right?
strings.네, %s 님 덕분에 저를 비롯해서 네레이스 관문은 늘 평화로운 날을 보: Yes. Thanks to you, %s, life here at Nereis Gateway has been peaceful for all of us. Oh, are you on your way somewhere?
strings.아, 루리아라면…. 아이사르 강을 끼고 있는 마을이죠. 근처에 유적지가: Ah, Luria... A village beside the Isar River. There are ruins nearby, so many archaeologists visit.
strings.혹시 네레이스 관문에서 그곳으로 가는 게이트가 있나요?: Is there a gate here at Nereis Gateway that leads there?
strings.아쉽지만 네레이스 관문에서 바로 가는 게이트는 없습니다. 대신 가시는 길: I'm afraid there's no direct gate. But I can tell you the way.
strings.수정달 숲에서 라란 가도로 이어진 길이 있는데, 그곳을 거치면 루리아 마: A path from Crystal Moon Forest leads to Laran Road. Follow that, and you'll reach Luria Village.
Huh. I didn't see a path to Laran Road when I visited Crystal Moon Forest...
strings.예전에 수정달 숲에 일어난 화재로 외부로 가는 길이 잘 보이지 않게 됐다: They say the fire in the forest long ago made the routes leading outside difficult to find.
strings.마을 사람이 아니면 길을 찾는 게 힘들다고 하니까 숲지기 엘프나 자주 가: Anyone who isn't from the village tends to get lost. Your best bet is to ask one of the elven forest keepers or someone who visits often.
strings.그러고 보니 관문의 일을 돕곤 하는 리코타 양이 오늘 라란 가도에 간다고: Come to think of it, Licota, who sometimes helps us at the gateway, said she was going to Laran Road today. Did you know?
strings.리코타 양이 몇 번 다녀왔고, 지리에도 밝으니까 동행하시는 건 어떻습니까: She's been several times and knows the area well. Why not go with her?
strings.네, 한 번 물어볼게요. 노토스 님, 저 리코에게 가볼게요. 나중에 뵙죠: I'll ask. I'm off to see Rico, Notos. See you later.
My break is over too. I'd better go attend to the gates.
strings.(아, 제피로스 이야기…. 제피로스가 직접 할 것 같은데, 내가 먼저 하: (Oh, about Zephyros... He probably wants to explain himself. I shouldn't say anything first, should I?)
strings.관문에서 지내면서 여러 임무를 끝냈어요. 보이는 것하고 보이지 않는 것: I've completed several missions while staying at the gateway. Both the visible kind and the less visible...
strings.모험가님은 잘 지내셨나요?: And how have you been, Adventurer?
strings.어디까지 말씀해 주실 수 있나요?: How much can you tell me?
strings.새삼스럽게…. 제가 도울 수 있는 일은 도와드리고 싶어요. 혹시 그동안: No need to be awkward about it... I want to help where I can. Have you met any more witches?
strings.(리코타에게 황혼의 성당에서 마녀 모르가나를 만났던 걸 간단하게 이야기한: (I briefly tell Licota about meeting the witch Morgana in the Twilight Cathedral.)
I had no idea anything like that had happened in Crystal Moon Forest...
strings.리프트라시르와 수정달 숲에 그런 힘이 요동쳤다면 분명 문라이트 단원들이: If such power was stirring in Lifthrasir and Crystal Moon Forest, surely the Moonlight members should have sensed something...
For us to have noticed nothing... A witch's power really is remarkable. Just like what happened on Aie Island.
And there isn't just one such witch, but several...
There's nothing you need to do right now, Rico. If something comes up, I'll ask.
strings.라란 가도로 간다고 했죠? 루리아 마을로 가는 길을 좀 알려줬으면 좋겠어: You said you're going to Laran Road, right? Could you show me the way to Luria Village? I need to meet someone...
strings.저도 가려고 하는데, 같이 가실래요? 아니면 제가 따로 알려드릴까요?: I'm headed that way too. Would you like to come with me, or should I just give you directions?
First, we'll take the gate to Lifthrasir and head into Crystal Moon Forest.
strings.정말 고마우시면 다음에 예쁜 인형 보시면 하나 챙겨주세요…. 그럼 출발할: If you're really grateful, pick up a pretty doll for me next time you find one... Let's go, then...
See that path? Follow it straight ahead, and you'll reach Laran Road.
Oh, so that's it. It's so obvious. Why didn't I see it before? Huh...
strings.(기분 탓이라기엔 조금 이상한데….): (It feels a little too strange to be my imagination...)
Yes... But I don't think it's especially dangerous.
If it meant to attack us, it would have done so already.
strings.저는 라란 가도 중심에 있는 장소까지만 안내해 드릴게요. 마침 오늘 레온: I'll guide you as far as the central part of Laran Road. Leon happens to be inspecting the facilities along the road today.
strings.루리아 마을 사람이에요. 라란 가도를 지나다가 이것저것 물어보니까 친절하: He's from Luria Village. When I asked him some questions on my way through, he kindly explained everything.
strings.그렇군요. 그러면 가볼까요?: I see. Shall we go, then?
strings.(푸른 산과 언덕 사이로 흐르는 강을 막아버린 것 같은 커다란 댐이 보인: (A vast dam seems to hold back the river flowing between green mountains and hills. Flecks of spray drift over the travelers, bringing a refreshing coolness.)
strings.저도 처음에 그랬어요. 임무 때문에 지나가는 곳인데, 풍경 보고 감탄하고: That was my reaction too. I was just passing through on a mission, but I couldn't help admiring the view.
To build something so magnificent without harming the natural surroundings...
strings.어, 리코리코타? 요즘 자주 보네?: Oh, Rico-Licota? I've been seeing you a lot lately!
strings.(누군가 친근하게 리코타를 부르자 %s의 시선이 자연스레 옮겨간다.): (At the familiar greeting to Licota, %s instinctively turns toward the voice.)
strings.(리코타를 멋대로 부르던 사람이 뒤에서 앞으로 걸어 나온다.): (The person taking such liberties with Licota's name steps forward from behind them.)
strings.(커다란 사람의 등장에 고개를 들어 앞을 바라보자 보통 인물이 아닌 존재: (The adventurer looks up at the towering newcomer and finds someone far from ordinary.)
strings.내가 레온 맞아. 당신, 모험가?: That's me. Leon. Are you an adventurer?
strings.(늑대 수인이 씨익 웃으며 악수를 청한다.): (The wolf beastfolk grins and offers a handshake.)
Nice to meet you, Leon. I'm %s...
%s, %s... I've heard that name before. Where was it?
strings.그런데 %s, 수인 보고 안 놀라? 이렇게 잘생기고 귀여운 늑대인간이면: But aren't you surprised to see a beastfolk, %s? Shouldn't a werewolf this handsome and cute make more of an impression?
strings.다른 대륙에서 레온과 비슷한 사람들을 본 적이 있어요. 엘 아노르 근처에: I've met people like you on other continents. And I've seen other beastfolk near El Anor.
strings.사람? 모험가, 지금 나한테 사람이라고 했어?: People? Adventurer, did you just call me a person?
strings.와아! 너 다른 사람들과 다르구나. 고마워, 완전 좋아! 모험가, 최고야: Wow! You're different from the others. Thank you! I love it! You're the best, Adventurer!
strings.(레온이 활짝 웃으며 %s의 두 팔을 붙잡고 흔든다.): (Leon beams, grabs %s by both arms, and shakes them enthusiastically.)
strings.(악수할 때부터 느낀 건데 힘이 엄청 세네.): (I noticed it during the handshake, but he's incredibly strong.)
Leon, don't squeeze %s's hands so hard.
strings.아, 미안. 날 보통 사람처럼 대해서 너무 기뻤거든. 그래서 내가 코리코: Oh, sorry. I was just so happy you treated me like any other person. That's why I like Cori-Cori too.
strings.후우, 레온…. 부를 거면 하나로 통일해주세요. 리코면 리코, 리코타면: Sigh... Leon. Please choose one name and stick to it. Rico or Licota.
strings.그래, 리코타. 오늘은 무슨 일이야?: Sure, Licota. What brings you here today?
strings.%s 님에게 루리아 마을을 안내해 주세요. 저는 다른 곳으로 가야 하거든: Please show %s the way to Luria Village. I need to go elsewhere.
If you're busy, Leon, directions will be fine.
No, I just finished my rounds. Nothing much wrong, so I was about to head back. Good timing. I got to see Coco-Li too.
strings.레온, 오늘은 여기서 헤어지지만, 다음에 만날 때에도 제대로 부르지 않으: Leon, we're parting here today. But if you get my name wrong next time...
I'll tie you up and toss you into the Abyss Chamber, Purgatory, or the Twilight Cathedral.
I don't know where those places are, but they sound dangerous.
Then please take good care of %s, Leon.
(With a farewell, Rico quickly heads toward a fork in the road in the distance.)
Oh, right. I forgot I had a favor to ask Rico-Rico.
strings.최근에 라란 가도에 종종 보던 야생동물들이 사나워졌어. 게다가 어디서 나: Lately, the wild animals we often see along Laran Road have turned aggressive. And strange monsters have appeared from who knows where...
strings.걔네들한테 포위당해 살려달라고 빌고 있던 걸 리코타가 구해줬거든. 그래서: They had me surrounded, and I was begging for help when Licota rescued me. So I thought maybe this time too...
strings.모험가, 지금 이건 못 들은 거야. 마을 가서 절대, 절대로 마을 사람들: Adventurer, you didn't hear that. When we get to the village, you must never, ever tell anyone.
strings.분명 강아지 취급받을 거야. 난 늑댄데, 자꾸 정체성을 잃게 만든단 말이: They'll treat me like a puppy again. I'm a wolf, but they keep making me question my identity.
strings.알았어요. 그러면 동물들을 진정시키고, 몬스터처럼 보이는 것들을 정리하면: All right. So I need to calm the animals and deal with those things that look like monsters?
strings.(…뭔가 속은 기분이 들지만, 일단 도와줘야겠다.): (...I feel a little tricked, but I'll help him.)
strings.후후. 모험가! 힘내라, 모험가!: Hehe. Go, Adventurer! You can do it!
Wow, amazing! You're the best, Adventurer.
strings.이제 된 건가요?: Does that take care of it?
strings.리코타도 그렇고, 모험가도 그렇고 요즘 젊은 사람들은 뭘 먹고 이렇게 훌: You and Licota... What are young people eating these days to turn out so impressive?
strings.(레온은 몇 살인거지? 늑대인간이라 가늠이 잘 안되네.): (How old is Leon? It's hard to tell with a werewolf.)
If you don't mind my asking, how old are you...?
strings.미안. 미안. 헬레나 할머니하고 이야기를 많이 했더니 할머니 말투가 옮았: Sorry, sorry! I've been talking with Grandma Helena so much, I must have picked up the way she talks. Sorry!
strings.혹시 예의를 허공해로 날려 보낸 사람이라고 생각한 거야?: Did you think I'd tossed my manners into the Void Sea?
strings.농담이야, 농담. 모험가. 맘에 들어! 좋아, 모험가! 그러면 마을로 가: I'm joking, Adventurer. I like you! You're great! Come on, let's go to the village.
strings.미안하지만, 가는 길에 방금 했던 거 한 번 더 해야 해. 마티아스 아저: Sorry, but we'll have to do that once more on the way. Matthias says the road into the village has to be safe for Jun...
I'll explain on the way. Come on! Hee!
strings.(너무 얼렁뚱땅인데….): (He's awfully good at glossing things over...)
strings.아, 레온! 같이 가요! 나 여기 길 몰라요!: Leon, wait for me! I don't know the way!
strings.(마을에 들어서자 마자 바람을 따라 풍차와 물레방아가 돌아가는 모습이 두: (Upon entering the village, the adventurer sees windmills turning in the breeze and waterwheels spinning in the current.)
It's beautiful here too. I want to take a walk right away...
strings.그렇지? 우리 루리아 마을에 한 번도 오지 않은 사람은 있어도, 한 번만: Isn't it? Some people have never visited Luria Village, but nobody visits only once. Hehe.
strings.그건 그렇고, 모험가. 멋지잖아. 그 많은 녀석을 그렇게 쉽게 상대할 수: Anyway, Adventurer, you're amazing. How did you handle so many of them so easily?
You were impressive too, Leon. Scaring off all those animals and defeating the monsters.
strings.에이, 허공해로 띄우지 마. 모험가에 비하면 평범한 동네 사람인걸. 아,: Oh, don't flatter me all the way up to the Void Sea. Compared with you, I'm just an ordinary local. Or an ordinary local beastfolk?
strings.그런데 모험가, 우리 마을에서 뭐 할 거야?: So, Adventurer, what are you going to do in our village?
strings.친구? 모험가 친구라면 분명 대단한 사람이겠지?: A friend? A friend of yours must be someone amazing, right?
strings.(갑자기 레온의 움직임이 느려지더니 이내 멈춰버린다. 마치 누군가 장난이: (Leon's movements suddenly slow, then stop altogether. As though someone were playing a trick, %s's vision distorts.)
strings.(%s 주위로 지나가던 사람들의 발걸음 또한 어느새 느려지다 못해 멈춰버: (The footsteps of everyone passing %s also slow to a halt. Just then, a familiar figure materializes beside the villagers.)
strings.(이름을 불린 존재가 천천히 %s의 옆으로 다가온다.): (At the sound of her name, the figure slowly approaches %s.)
I meant to pass through quietly, but you recognized me.
strings.저번에도 그랬지만, 오늘도 당신에게 볼일이 없어요. 아, 혹시 이 말을: Just like last time, I have no business with you today. Oh, do you remember those words?
Judging by your expression, you do...
Stop wasting words and tell me what you're doing here...
strings.그렇게 제 이야기를 듣고 싶은 건가요? 그러면 마을에서 벗어난 곳에서 말: You want to hear my story that badly? Then I'll tell you somewhere outside the village.
strings.의심 많은 사람…. 제가 당신 요구 때문에 예정에도 없던 마을을 볼모로: Such a suspicious person... Must I take this village hostage, though I'd never planned to, just to satisfy your demand?
strings.라란 가도 어딘가에 사람의 발길이 닿지 않는 곳이 있을 거예요. 당신이: There's a place along Laran Road where no one goes. Follow the strange power you sense, and you'll find me...
strings.(다프네가 미소를 지으며 등을 돌린다. 그리고 사람들 사이로 걸어 나간다: (Daphne smiles and turns away, walking between the villagers. As her form fades like an illusion, the village's slowed time returns to normal.)
strings.(정신을 차리고 주위를 살펴보던 %s의 앞에 걱정하듯 쳐다보는 레온의 시: (Collecting their thoughts and looking around, %s meets Leon's worried gaze.)
strings.모험가, 왜 혼자 떠드는 거야? 피곤해서 그래?: Adventurer, why are you talking to yourself? Are you tired?
strings.아, 아뇨. 아, 레온, 하나만 물어볼게요. 가도에 사람이 가지 않을만한: Oh, no. Leon, one question. Is there somewhere along the road that people don't visit?
strings.어, 있긴 해. 정말 아무 것도 없는 공터가 하나 있어. 원래는 그곳에: There is. An empty clearing with absolutely nothing in it. The Magic Bureau was going to build a warehouse there, but...
strings.응. 아…. 이거 알려주는 건 마티아스 아저씨 몫인데…. 혹시 설명 필요: Yes. Ah... Explaining that is Matthias's job... Do you need to hear about it?
I'll hear it later. I'm in a hurry...
I'd like to show you the way, but I've got work to do in the village...
That's all right. Just tell me how to get there.
strings.(레온이 삐뚤빼뚤 그린 라란 가도의 안내도 때문에 굳이 헤매지 않아도 되: (Leon's crooked map sends the adventurer wandering unnecessarily. Eventually, their steps come to a halt at what looks like the end of Laran Road.)
Here it is. An empty clearing, just as Leon said...
strings.다프네, 이제 나와. 어디 있는 거야?: Daphne, come out. Where are you?
strings.(멀리 강과 댐이 보이는 것 외에는 아무것도 없는 곳이라고 인식했을 때,: (Just as the adventurer concludes that there is nothing here but a distant view of the river and dam, the air begins to change.)
Daphne, come out. Keep your word.
strings.(주위를 살피고 있던 %s의 뒤로 다프네가 아닌 여성의 목소리가 들려온다: (As %s looks around, a woman's voice sounds behind them. It is not Daphne's.)
strings.(붉은색 리본과 장미로 장식된 블랙 고딕 드레스 차림의 금발 여성이 천천: (A blonde woman in a black Gothic dress adorned with red ribbons and roses slowly passes %s.)
strings.토끼 마녀는 처음부터 그대에게 약속 같은 건 하지 않았다. 제대로 약속했: The rabbit witch never promised you anything. If she had made a true promise, she could not have broken it...
strings.마녀는 마녀를 만날 수밖에 없는 건가?: Are witches destined to encounter other witches?
Daphne, if you have business with me, Pandora, stop playing games and show yourself...
strings.(자신을 판도라라고 밝힌 여성의 말이 끝나자, 주위를 감싸고 있던 장막이: (As the woman who named herself Pandora finishes speaking, the veils surrounding them fall away one by one. A woman with twitching, long ears appears between them.)
strings.이렇게 보는 건 처음이죠? 어떤 만남을 좋아하는지 몰라서 많이 고민했어요: This is our first meeting, isn't it? I wasn't sure what sort of encounter you'd prefer, so I gave it a great deal of thought. Do you like it, Pandora?
I dislike your toying with %s. But if it was to meet me, I'll give you credit for that.
%s, I know you have much to say to her, but please step back for a moment. That rabbit witch used you because of me.
%s, you're so kind to Pandora. You could show me that side of you too.
strings.쓸데없는 이야기는 그만…. 다프네, 그대는 밤에 얼마나 다가간 거지?: Enough pointless chatter... Daphne, how close have you come to the night?
Deep night is still far away. But with your help, I should manage.
strings.그대가 원하는 밤과 나의 밤이 서로 다를 텐데, 왜 도와달라고 하는 건지: The night you seek and mine are different. I don't see why you would ask for my help.
strings.판도라, 당신이 날 도와준다면 아무런 문제가 없을 거예요. 아무도 다치지: Pandora, if you help me, there won't be a problem. No one will be hurt. Levi included...
strings.(다프네가 레비를 언급한 순간, 다프네의 뺨에 있던 상처에서 핏방울이 터: (The moment Daphne mentions Levi, blood bursts from the wound on her cheek.)
Hehe. Just as I expected. He is precious to you.
strings.(다프네가 아무렇지도 않은 듯이 피를 닦는다.): (Daphne wipes away the blood as though it were nothing.)
It sounds as though you wouldn't mind my killing you here...
strings.판도라, 정말로 절 죽일 수 있겠나요?: Pandora, can you truly kill me?
You know what would happen. If you kill me, you'll never see Levi again. And you'll never reach the goal you seek.
strings.(어느샌가 다가온 짙은 어둠이 다프네 앞에 벽을 만든다. 그리고 그 벽: (Dense darkness gathers into a wall before Daphne. The witch's smile behind it stops Pandora and %s in their tracks.)
strings.상자를 열 준비는 됐나요?: Are you ready to open the box?
strings.(그 말과 함께 어둠이 유리 깨지듯 산산조각 난다. 그리고 뒤에 서 있던: (With those words, the darkness shatters like glass. Daphne's figure behind it also breaks into fragments and scatters.)
strings.(잠시 머물렀던 어둠이 사라지면서 차가운 라란 가도의 공기가 느껴진다.): (The lingering darkness fades, leaving the cold air of Laran Road.)
strings.(판도라가 허탈한 표정으로 하늘을 바라보고 있다.): (Pandora stares at the sky, looking hollow.)
strings.저택을 나온 순간부터 각오는 했어. 하지만, 레비의 이름을 듣는 것만으로: I knew what I was facing when I left the mansion. Yet merely hearing Levi's name renders me helpless...
I noticed it when we first met. You're always looking after others.
Perhaps that's what has kept you alive and made you strong.
Levi said I should praise people for their good qualities.
strings.그런가? 힘을 조금씩 되찾아 가면서 이 모습이 되긴 했지. 내 원래의 모: Do I? As I regain my power, little by little, I've taken this form. Though returning to my original appearance may be difficult...
Still, I've recovered enough to reach the Freios continent.
strings.(변했다는 게 그런 의미는 아니지만….): (That isn't quite the change I meant...)
strings.%s, 그대는 돌아가는 게 좋겠어. 여전히 마녀의 밤에 다가가는 건 위험: %s, you should go back. Approaching the witches' night is still dangerous.
I know about the witches' fate.
How much do you know? Don't tell me...
strings.밤을 쫓는 자의 운명을 선사한 자를 만났군. 그리고 밤을 쫓는 자들끼리: You've met the one who bestowed the fate of those who pursue the night. And you know that they kill one another...
I knew you were carrying out errands for the God of the Astral Realm, but I never expected you to learn this much.
strings.무슨 말을 할지 알고 있어. 내가 마녀라도 죽였을까 봐?: I know what you're going to ask. Whether I've killed any witches?
I do not kill witches. I never have.
strings.아가슈라인 내가 마녀의 운명을 받고도 그런 짓을 하지 않았다는 게 믿기지: You must find it hard to believe that an Agasura like me, given a witch's fate, has never done such a thing.
strings.그리고 레비도 같이 찾아요. 저는 레비를 설득하기 위해서 이곳에 왔으니까: And let's find Levi together. I came here to persuade him.
strings.레비가 판도라를 찾기 위해 프레이오스 대륙에 있다면 다른 마녀의 타겟이: If Levi is in Freios searching for you, other witches could target him.
strings.그래서 이리스에게 레비를 설득해 지엔디아로 돌아가게 해달라는 부탁을 받았: That's why Iris asked me to persuade him to return to Jiendia.
strings.레비가 루리아 마을로 가고 있다고 해서 오긴 했는데, 판도라를 만나게 될: I heard he was coming to Luria Village, so I came here. I didn't expect to meet you instead.
strings.무슨 일로 여기 왔는지 알려줄 수 있어요?: Can you tell me why you're here?
strings.레비에게 줄게 있는데, 그게 라란 가도 어딘가에 있어. 그걸 위해서 이곳: There's something I want to give Levi, somewhere along Laran Road. That's why I came. And I know what you're worried about.
strings.내가 레비를 위해서 하는 일은 절대로 레비가 싫어하는 수단과 방법이 되진: Nothing I do for Levi will ever involve methods he would despise.
Let's find him together. The rabbit witch may be playing another trick.
Then let's go to the village.
strings.사람 많은 건 불편하니까 마을 사람들에겐 그대가 말을 걸었으면 해. 나는: Crowds make me uncomfortable. I'd like you to speak to the villagers. I'm not used to such things...
Oh, all right. I'll lead the way.
You really are difficult to understand...
strings.(그건 그렇고 마을에 가서 누구한테 먼저 말을 걸어야 하지.): (Who should I talk to first when we get back?)
strings.(아, 레온이 마티아스 아저씨라는 사람 이야기를 계속했지. 누군지 이야기: (Oh, Leon kept mentioning someone named Matthias. He said he'd tell me who that was...)
strings.(일단 그 사람에게 가보자. 물어보면 뭐라도 알아내겠지.): (Let's find him first. Maybe he'll know something.)
strings.(근육질의 우람한 체격을 가진 사내가 자신을 찾아오는 낯선 여행자를 빤히: (A burly, muscular man studies the unfamiliar traveler approaching him.)
strings.처음 보는 사람인데, 여행자신가?: I haven't seen you before. A traveler?
strings.루리아에는 처음 오는 여행자입니다. 마티아스 씨 맞죠?: It's my first visit to Luria. You're Matthias, correct?
strings.나는 이 마을의 촌장, 아니… 대표 마티아스라고 하네만, 무슨 일로 날: I'm the village chief... no, representative, Matthias. What brings you to me?
Oh, let me introduce myself. I'm %s...
strings.어쨌든, 뭔가 찾는 것 같은데, 내가 도와드리지. 혼자 오셨나?: Anyway, it looks as though you're searching for something. I'll help. Did you come alone?
strings.(눈이 마주친 판도라가 앞을 보라는 고갯짓을 한다.): (Meeting the adventurer's eyes, Pandora gestures for them to face forward.)
I'm not with anyone. I'm looking for someone, Chief.
Chief... no, representative... Oh, just call me Matthias.
strings.나는 촌장이 좋은데, 딸내미가 촌장이라는 호칭을 옛날 사람 같다 그래서: I like "chief," but my daughter hates it. She says it makes me sound old-fashioned.
strings.그래서 뭘 찾고 있지?: So, what are you looking for?
Hmm... A name alone won't help much. What does he look like?
strings.금발에 푸른 눈동자를 가진 청년인데, 뭇 여성들이 첫눈에 반해 사랑을 고: A young man with blond hair and blue eyes. He's handsome enough to make women fall in love at first sight and confess on the spot.
strings.하아…. 그 정도면 쥰이 만나면 안 되는 사람이겠군. 아, 쥰은 내 사랑: Ah... Then he's someone Jun mustn't meet. Jun is my lovely daughter. Her name is actually Juen, but everyone calls her Jun.
strings.(레온이 말했던 사람이 마티아스 씨 딸이구나.): (So the person Leon mentioned is Matthias's daughter.)
Ah! I remember! I think that handsome fellow was in the village.
strings.며칠 전에 마을 숙녀들이 기쁜 비명을 지르면서 달려 나갔거든. 어디 가시: A few days ago, the ladies all ran out squealing with delight. "Where are you going? Won't you look this way for a moment?" That sort of thing.
strings.지금은 어디에 있는지 모르겠군. 오늘도 마을을 둘러봤는데, 매일 보던 사: I don't know where he is now. I made the rounds today, but only saw the usual faces...
It's hard to keep track of where every visitor is staying. Sorry.
Jun could hand out snacks and get the children playing detective. They'd find him in no time. But she's out on the road right now...
No, thank you for the offer. I'll look around a little more.
strings.흐음…, 그러면 누구에게 물어보지?: Hmm... Who should I ask next?
I'd better look around the village again.
Sorry, traveler! I made you fall, and broke your glasses too.
strings.(레온이 자신과 부딪혀 쓰러진 연희를 향해 손을 뻗는다.): (Leon offers a hand to Yeonhee, who fell after colliding with him.)
It's all right. I have spare glasses.
strings.(연희가 환하게 웃으며 앞에 있는 사람을 붙잡으려 한다.): (Yeonhee smiles brightly and reaches for the person in front of her.)
strings.(깜짝 놀란 판도라가 재빨리 물러나자 아무 것도 잡지 못한 연희가 바닥에: (Startled, Pandora quickly steps back. Grasping only empty air, Yeonhee falls flat on the ground.)
strings.(연희가 눈을 비비며 %s에게 말을 거는 것 같지만, 시선은 레온을 향해: (Yeonhee rubs her eyes and seems to address %s, though she is looking at Leon.)
Without my glasses, it's rather hard to tell people apart.
Do I look like the adventurer...? Anyway, sorry. I'll pay for the glasses.
strings.저는 정말 괜찮은데, 보상해 주신다니 어쩔 수 없죠. 방금 깨진 게 실바: I'm really all right, but if you insist on compensating me... Those were specially made by the Silvaria Empire's Magic Bureau. About three billion Ely...
I don't have that much money... I'm sorry.
I'm joking. Actually, three hundred million Ely...
Have mercy... That's expensive too. Waaah.
It was partly my fault for not looking where I was going. Please don't worry.
strings.(연희가 새로운 안경을 꺼내 착용한다.): (Yeonhee takes out another pair of glasses and puts them on.)
strings.후아, 이제야 잘 보이네요. 제가 안경을 안 쓰면 눈에 뵈는 게 없어서…: Phew, now I can see. Without my glasses, I can't see a thing... Would you tell me your name?
strings.레온, 레온…. 좋은 이름이네요. 레온, 신경써줘서 고마워요. 저는 지엔: Leon, Leon... What a nice name. Thank you for your concern, Leon. I'm Yeonhee, from Elias on the Jiendia continent.
You seem to know the adventurer. Is that why you weren't surprised to see me?
strings.마을에 찾아온 손님이니까 궁금하거나 필요한 게 있으면 언제나 불러. 내가: You're a guest in our village. If you need anything or have any questions, just call me. I'll take good care of you.
strings.저녁에 생선 요리 준비할 건데, 먹을래?: I'm making fish for dinner. Want some?
Hehe. I certainly won't turn that down.
Great! Then I'll catch something good! When you get hungry, howl here. All right? See you!
strings.(레온이 손을 흔들며 그대로 마을 뒤쪽 강을 향해 뛰어간다.): (Leon waves and runs toward the river behind the village.)
I'm looking forward to trying the local fish dishes. But what was howling again...? Oh, when puppies go "awoooo." How adorable.
strings.아, 연희 님. 그동안 잘 지내셨어요?: Oh, Yeonhee. How have you been?
strings.저야 늘 잘 지낸답니다. 이번에는 길도 잃지 않았고요. 수도에 갔다가 루: I'm always well. And I didn't even get lost this time. I heard about Luria in the capital and came straight here. I'm glad I did.
strings.그런데 %s 님께서는 어쩐 일로 오신 거예요? 보통 일은 아니신 것 같은: What brings you here, %s? It doesn't seem like an ordinary visit...
Oh, right. You know Levi, don't you? Levi Arens...
strings.당연히 알고 있지요. 엘리아스에서 레비 님을 모르면 쭈꾸미만도 못하니까요: Of course. Anyone in Elias who doesn't know Levi must have less sense than an octopus. Has something happened to him?
strings.그건 아니고…. 개인적인 일로 찾는 중인데, 며칠 전에 마을에 왔었다는: No... I'm looking for him on personal business. I heard he came to the village a few days ago.
So I thought I'd ask whether you knew anything.
I arrived late yesterday, so I haven't seen him.
If I see Levi, I'll tell him you're looking for him, %s.
And if I find him, I'll give him your regards.
strings.꼭 빨리 찾으셨으면 좋겠어요. 나쁜 일은 아니겠죠?: I hope you find him soon. It isn't anything bad, is it?
strings.다행이에요. 아, 저쪽에 어르신 한 분이 계신데, 그분께는 물어보셨나요?: That's a relief. Oh, there's an elderly lady over there. Have you asked her?
She's very kind. She helped me find my way around the village.
Enjoy your trip. See you again, Yeonhee.
strings.(연희가 손을 흔들며 %s에게 배웅 인사를 한다. 그리고 작은 천으로 안: (Yeonhee waves goodbye to %s. Then, while cleaning her glasses with a small cloth, she gazes into the distance as though noticing something.)
strings.(저 여자, 지금 나와 마주친 건 아니겠지?): (She didn't just meet my eyes, did she?)
Now I can finally see the scenery properly. I must write down all my impressions. Hehe.
strings.(안경을 다시 착용한 연희가 이리저리 둘러보며 마을의 모습에 감탄한다.): (With her glasses back on, Yeonhee looks around and admires the village.)
strings.(판도라가 낚시터를 구경하러 가는 연희의 뒷모습을 확인하고 서둘러 %s의: (After watching Yeonhee head toward the fishing spot, Pandora hurries after %s.)
strings.(노년 여성이 멀리서 낯선 사람의 모습이 보이자, 앞을 바라본다. 그리고: (An elderly woman notices an unfamiliar figure in the distance and looks up, closing the book she had been reading over tea.)
strings.(노년의 여성이 알아본다는 것도 모른 채, %s의 발걸음이 바쁘게 움직인: (Unaware of the elderly woman's recognition, %s hurries onward. Pandora catches the collar of %s's clothing.)
That woman is no ordinary person.
strings.문제 될 건 없어 보이는데요?: I don't see any reason for concern.
strings.알았어. 그러면 그대가 물어봐. 어차피 내가 저 사람 눈에 보이진 않겠지: All right. You ask her, then. She shouldn't be able to see me anyway...
strings.(노년의 여성이 찻잔을 테이블에 놓고 다가오는 %s의 얼굴을 빤히 바라본: (The elderly woman sets her teacup on the table and studies %s's approaching face.)
I thought you had come knowing who I was. Apparently not.
I'm not sure what you mean. I just wanted to ask the villagers something...
I see. Then let me introduce myself. I am Helena Silvaria.
strings.(헬레나라고 자신을 소개한 노년의 여성이 %s의 반응이 재미있는지 작은: (The elderly woman who introduced herself as Helena smiles faintly, amused by %s's reaction.)
strings.뭘 그렇게 놀라죠. 내가 폐하와 데이나, 시이나의 고모 할머니 되는 사람: Why so surprised? I'm the great-aunt of Her Majesty, Dayna, and Shiina.
Oh, you're a member of the imperial family. I thought you had a similar air.
strings.이 사람은 반쪽이라 뭐라 말하기 어렵군요. 정실 황비에게서 태어난 아이가: Only in part, you might say. I wasn't born to the emperor's principal consort... Though my elder brother cared for me dearly. Hehe.
strings.별 이야길 다하는군요. %s의 이야기는 많이 들었어요. 그래서 바로 알아: Listen to me ramble. I've heard a great deal about you, %s. That's how I recognized you at once.
You thought I'd heard about you before coming...
strings.그래서 용건이 뭐죠? %s…. 개인적으로는 제국과 관련된 일이 아니었으면: So, what brings you here, %s? Personally, I hope it has nothing to do with the Empire.
It isn't imperial business. I'm looking for someone for personal reasons.
It must be important. I don't know how much help I can be...
A young man traveling from Jiendia. Blond hair, blue eyes...
strings.레비 아렌스라고 하던가요? 아름답고 기품이 넘치는 데다가 사람들을 자연스: Levi Arens, was it? A beautiful, graceful young man whose charm naturally drew people to him...
strings.요즘 보기 드문 잘생긴 청년이라 기억하지요. 살면서 그 정도 미모는 많이: I remember him. You rarely see such a handsome young man these days. I've met few people so beautiful in all my years.
strings.이 사람이 은퇴한 고고학자인 걸 어떻게 알았는지 유적에 관해 이것저것 묻: Somehow, he knew I was a retired archaeologist. He asked me all sorts of questions about the ruins.
You were an archaeologist? Oh, I thought those things over there looked like artifacts...
You have a good eye. I've loved history and artifacts since I was young, so I made them my work.
strings.마을 근처에 있는 에기르 유적을 발견하기도 했고, 유물을 연구해서 테오도: I discovered the Aegir Ruins near the village. Studying their artifacts also revealed a few stories that Theodore would enjoy.
That's impressive. And you know the professor too.
I think of Theo as a nephew.
strings.그러시구나…. 아, 그 후로, 레비를 본 적이 있으신가요?: I see... Have you seen Levi since then?
No, I haven't seen that young man since our conversation.
strings.마을로 돌아왔다면 여자아이들이 행복한 비명을 질렀겠죠. 쥬엔도 식사 때: If he'd returned to the village, the girls would have squealed with delight. And Juen would have spent dinner asking, "Grandma, did you see him?"
strings.헬레나 님, 제가 유적에 들어갈 수 있을까요? 확인해 보고 싶은 게 있어: Helena, may I enter the ruins? There's something I'd like to check.
You don't need my permission. But if you go inside, be careful.
strings.유적에 뭔가 있나요?: Is there something in the ruins?
strings.이 사람이 은퇴 후에 다른 고고학자들이 유적지를 조사하다가 다친 일이 있: After I retired, other archaeologists were injured while investigating them. Artifacts and mechanisms we'd studied endlessly without understanding suddenly began to move...
strings.제가 확인하려고 했지만, 폐하께서 어떻게 아시고 말리더군요. 예지를 보신: I meant to inspect them myself, but somehow Her Majesty found out and stopped me. She must have seen a vision.
strings.그래서 기사단을 파견해서 조사하고 그것들이 특수한 상황에서 움직인다는 결: So she sent knights to investigate. They concluded that those things activate under certain conditions.
strings.아이들에게서 당신이 강한 사람이라는 건 들어 알고 있지만 조심해서 나쁠거: The girls have told me how strong you are, but there's no harm in being careful.
I will be. I'll be all right.
strings.마을 바깥에 멀리 커다란 바위 같은 게 세워져 있는데, 보이나요? 저기가: Do you see that enormous rock-like structure outside the village? Those are the Aegir Ruins.
strings.그러면 %s, 원하는 걸 잘 찾을 수 있길 빌게요. 그리고 쥬엔이라는 아: I hope you find what you're seeking, %s. And if Juen is outside the ruins, please tell her to come home before sunset.
I'll pass your message on to Juen.
Thank you. Oh, look at the time... I should go and rest.
Oh, I'm sorry I kept you...
strings.아니에요. 이 나이 되면 자연스러운 일인게죠. 후후. 그럼 나중에 또 만: No, no. It's only natural at my age. Hehe. Until next time, %s.
strings.(헬레나가 자리를 비우자, 판도라가 조용히 %s의 어깨를 두드린다.): (Once Helena leaves, Pandora quietly taps %s on the shoulder.)
strings.그대 말이 맞았어. 헬레나라는 사람, 보통은 아니지만, 문제가 될 건 없: You were right. Helena is no ordinary woman, but she poses no problem.
Let's go... I need to look inside the ruins. I can faintly sense Levi.
(A short-haired girl in explorer's clothes shakes a creature that appears to be a kind of Priring.)
strings.먹이 활동도 안하면서 주는 것도 곱게 안 먹냐?! 다른 동네 프리링은 이: You don't even find your own food, and now you're turning your nose up at what I bring?! The Prirings in other places love this stuff!
strings.(날개 달린 프리링이 입에서 퉤-하고 사료로 보이는 걸 뱉어낸다.): (The winged Priring spits out what appears to be feed with a loud "ptooey.")
Dad told me over and over not to feed the Hefrings. Well, goodbye, Hefrings. No food for any of you tomorrow.
strings.(소녀에게 헤프링이라고 불린 생물이 소녀의 말을 알아들은 건지 패닉에 빠: (The creature she calls a Hefring looks panicked, as though understanding her words.)
strings.(하지만, 금방 여유만만한 표정으로 배를 보인 채 드러눕는다.): (But it quickly regains its composure and flops onto its back, belly exposed.)
Oh, you! Do you think that'll make me stop being angry? You're awful, Hefring.
strings.귀, 귀엽잖아!! 이, 이런 식이면 내가 밥 계속 가져다 줄줄 알고?: Y-you're too cute!! You think I'll keep bringing food if you act like that?
(The girl rubs the Hefring's belly and shakes a treat taken from her pocket. Its eyes sparkle as it waves its forepaws.)
strings.오늘은 주긴 주는데, 이번 한번 뿐이야. 후우. 진짜 고고학자 언니오빠들: I'll give you some today, but just this once. Sigh. Those archaeologists really spoiled you rotten.
strings.혹시 쥬엔이에요? 쥰?: Excuse me, are you Juen? Jun?
strings.네, 쥬엔이랍니다. 쥰이기도 하고요, 어?: Yes, I'm Juen. Jun too. Huh?
strings.딱 봐도 멋진 모험가의 모습을 하고 계셔서 저도 모르게 놀랐어요! 완전: You look like such an amazing adventurer that I couldn't help it! You're incredible!
I've never heard that before. You caught me off guard. I'm %s...
strings.%s 님? %s? 와아아아아!! 혹시 그, 그분이신가요? 온갖 악당들을: %s? %s? Wooooow! Are you that person? The champion of justice who defeated all those villains? The goddess's maniac?! Huh? The maniac of justice?
Ahaha... You've got the wrong idea. I'm an adventurer.
strings.멋진 분을 이렇게 만날 줄이야. 너무 감격스러워요. 그런데 유적에는 무슨: I can't believe I'm meeting someone so amazing. I'm overwhelmed! What brings you to the ruins?
I'm looking for something. I've already spoken with Helena.
strings.아, 맞다. 헬레나 님께서 해지기 전에 돌아오라고 말씀 전해달라고 했어요: Oh, right. She asked me to tell you to come home before sunset.
strings.네, 그래야죠. 그런데 모험가님! 할머니께 이야기 들으셨다면 위험할 텐데: Of course. But, Adventurer! If you've spoken with Grandma, you know it's dangerous... Will you be all right?
I'll be fine. I'm used to this sort of thing...
strings.우왕, 멋지다. 저도 모험가님처럼 탐험하고 싶은데…. 안 되겠죠?: Wow, so cool. I want to explore like you... But I suppose I can't?
Perhaps not right now, but someday you can. Don't give up.
Eee! What wonderful advice. Thank you!
Oh, right! There are lots of hungry Hefrings inside, so be careful.
strings.전에 에기르 유적을 찾아온 고고학자들이 처음 보고 신기하다고 맛있는 간식: Apparently, the archaeologists who first came to the Aegir Ruins thought they were fascinating and fed them tasty treats.
strings.그 후로는 먹이 찾는 활동을 그만두고 고고학자들 곁에서 간식만 얻어먹는: After that, they stopped foraging and started living off snacks from the archaeologists.
My dad weighs as much as a heavy log, and these little guys weigh about the same.
strings.저처럼 자주 보는 사람한테는 얘네들이 나름 힘 조절을 해서 다가오는데,: They're careful with people they see often, like me. But when they see someone new, they fly straight at them without holding back.
strings.얘네들과 부딪혀 허공해로 날아간 헤프링하고 탐험가들이 한 둘이 아니라면: Would you believe more than a few explorers and Hefrings have collided and gone flying into the Void Sea?
Adventurer, I have a favor to ask.
strings.탐험하시고 돌아오면 무슨 일 있었는지 이야기해 주세요!: When you get back from exploring, tell me what happened!
All right. That's easy enough. See you later, Juen.
strings.(엎어져서 간식을 먹던 헤프링이 모험가를 향해 앞팔을 흔든다.): (The Hefring, sprawled out eating its snack, waves a forepaw at the adventurer.)
I can sense Levi inside. We should hurry.
strings.(위압감이 느껴지는 에기르 유적 안, 잘 정돈된 길 사이에서 바람이 습한: (Inside the imposing Aegir Ruins, wind carrying the scent of damp earth blows through well-ordered passages.)
There are signs of age everywhere. They really are ancient ruins.
strings.(판도라가 앞으로 걸어가려는 순간, 커다란 랜스가 두 사람의 앞으로 떨어: (Just as Pandora steps forward, an enormous lance drops in front of them.)
It missed us, fortunately. Don't be frightened.
strings.이건 성스러운 힘이 깃든 무기…. 어쩐지…. 레비의 기운이 사라진 건 이: A weapon imbued with holy power... That explains it. Is this why Levi's presence vanished?
strings.(유적 안에서 고양이 같은 인상의 여성이 새하얀 날개를 펄럭거리며 다가온: (A woman with a catlike face approaches from inside the ruins, beating snow-white wings.)
strings.(전투 천사 미카엘라의 분위기를 닮은 여성이 바닥에 박혀 있는 커다란 랜: (With an air reminiscent of the battle angel Michaela, she effortlessly pulls the enormous lance from the ground.)
I've lived a long time, but this is my first encounter with a battle angel...
There's another one in a hidden place.
strings.(전투 천사가 빤히 두 사람을 바라보고는 랜스를 들어 겨눈다.): (The battle angel stares at them, then raises her lance.)
strings.라피가 말할 테니까 잘 들어. 여기는 위험해. 인간이 있을 자리가 아니야: Listen to Raphie. This place is dangerous. Humans don't belong here... W-wait. What are you?!
strings.(강렬한 붉은 색 방어구를 착용한 전투 천사가 당황한 표정을 짓는다.): (The battle angel in vivid red armor looks bewildered.)
strings.신의 가호를 받은 인간 중에 라피가 모르는 사람은 없는데…. 인간, 너: Raphie knows every human blessed by the gods... Human, what are you? And why are you with a demon?
strings.아가슈라를 모르는 건가…? 그리고 라피는 뭐지?: You don't know what an Agasura is...? And who is Raphie?
strings.아가슈라가 뭔데? 라피는 그런 거 몰라. 그리고 라피는 나. 내가 라피야: What's an Agasura? Raphie doesn't know anything about that. And Raphie is me. I'm Raphie.
strings.시간이 없다, %s…. 전투 천사는 내버려 두고 가자. 레비를 찾아야 해: There's no time, %s... Leave the battle angel. We need to find Levi.
strings.레비? 레비가 뭐야? 너희들이 찾는 건가?: Levi? What's Levi? Is that what you're looking for?
If a human blessed by the gods and a demon are searching together, it must be something very important.
strings.그거라면 라피도 여기서 나갈 수 있을지도…. 빨리 나가서 오르카 님을 도: Maybe it could help Raphie get out of here... I have to leave quickly and help Lord Orca.
strings.(전투 천사가 자신의 말이 끝나자마자 힘차게 날갯짓을 한다. 그리고는 빠: (The moment she finishes speaking, the battle angel beats her wings hard and flies deeper into the ruins.)
strings.저 천사님은 무슨 생각을 하는 거지? 납득이 되지 않네. 여기서 나가지: What is that angel thinking? I don't understand. If she can't leave, does that mean she's trapped...?
%s, stop thinking and come on. There's no need to puzzle over it here.
Oh, right. Let's hurry. We need to find Levi before she does.
(They search the Aegir Ruins thoroughly, but find no sign of Levi. Only suspicious artifacts and mechanisms, awakened by some unknown will, greet them.)
strings.(덤으로 사람, 아니 사람이 들고 있는 음식이 반갑다며 달려드는 헤프링까: (Along with Hefrings rushing to greet people... or rather, the food those people carry.)
strings.다들 조심하라고 한 이유가 있었네. 그나저나 레비는 어디 있는 거지?: Everyone had good reason to warn us. But where is Levi?
strings.레비의 영혼이 느껴져. 분명 이곳에 있는 것 같은데…. 왜 보이지 않지?: I can sense his soul. He must be here... Why can't we see him?
strings.여기에 왔다 간 거 맞을까요?: Are you sure he came here?
I don't know... I thought I knew everything about Levi...
strings.(에기르 유적에 처음 들어왔을 때처럼 판도라의 앞으로 커다란 랜스가 떨어: (Just as when they first entered the Aegir Ruins, an enormous lance falls in front of Pandora.)
Raphie has to leave this place. I have to get out and help Lord Orca.
strings.그러니까, 그러니까 라피와 상관없는 너희라도 라피를 방해하겠다면 쓰러뜨릴: So... even if you have nothing to do with Raphie, if you get in my way, I'll defeat you...
strings.라피를 라피로 부를 수 있는 건 오직 라피 뿐이야!: Only Raphie gets to call Raphie "Raphie"!
strings.(전투 천사가 크게 날개짓하자 유적 안에 있던 거대한 기운이 모여 강렬한: (The battle angel beats her wings, gathering the immense energy within the ruins into a fierce gale.)
strings.방해가 되는 건 날아가 버려!!: Everything in my way can blow away!!
strings.(전투 천사의 한 마디와 함께 마력의 결계를 펼치려던 판도라가 강렬한 바: (At the battle angel's words, the fierce wind sends Pandora flying before she can raise a magical barrier.)
strings.(얼마나 멀리 날아가 버렸는지 판도라의 모습이 보이지 않는다.): (Pandora is blown so far away that she vanishes from sight.)
strings.귀찮아서 멀리 날려버렸어. 지금 여기는 너와 라피, 둘 뿐이야. 레비라는: She was annoying, so I sent her far away. Now it's just you and Raphie. I'm going to find this Levi thing.
strings.(다시 한 번 %s의 옆으로 날카로운 랜스가 스쳐 지나간다.): (Once more, a sharp lance whistles past %s.)
Being blessed by a god doesn't give you the right to interfere with me.
Then I have no choice. I'll have to find a way to hold you back.
strings.해볼 테면 해보라고. 순순히 당해주진 않을 거니까!!: Try it if you can. I won't make it easy!!
strings.(전투 천사의 랜스가 %s의 반격에 튕겨 나간다.): (The battle angel's lance is knocked aside by %s's counterattack.)
strings.너 뭐야, 이럴 수 없는 거잖아. 어떻게 라피의 공격에 맞설 수 있는 거: What are you? This shouldn't be possible. How can you stand against Raphie's attacks?
Please, listen to me. Fighting like this won't get us anywhere.
strings.라피는 듣기 싫다고! 어우, 너 정말 귀찮네. 어떻게 해야 하지?: Raphie doesn't want to listen! Ugh, you're such a nuisance. What should I do?
strings.(순간, 전투 천사의 날개가 엄청나게 커진다. 날갯짓 한 번에 다시 유적: (The battle angel's wings suddenly grow enormous. One beat gathers the immense energy within the ruins into another fierce gale.)
strings.너도 여기서 나가버려!! 그리고 들어오지 마!: You can get out too!! And don't come back!
strings.(전투 천사가 일으킨 바람으로 %s의 몸이 어딘가로 날려가 그대로 바닥에: (The wind raised by the battle angel sends %s flying, then crashing to the ground somewhere else.)
strings.유적 출구 방향이잖아. 싸우다가 날려 보내는 건 대체 뭔데…. 후우, 다: The ruins' exit. Who just blows someone away in the middle of a fight...? Sigh. I have to get back inside.
strings.(날아온 쪽으로 발걸음을 옮기려고 하지만, 알 수 없는 힘의 장벽이 펼쳐: (The adventurer tries to retrace their path, but a barrier of unknown power blocks the way.)
strings.나도 그대도 왔던 길로 다시 들어갈 수 없다. 이대로는 아무것도 할 수: Neither of us can return the way we came. We can't do anything like this.
strings.천사와 대화해서 오해를 푸는 것이 먼저…. 멋대로 나타나긴 했지만, 천사: First, we need to talk to the angel and clear up the misunderstanding... She appeared so abruptly, but it cannot be a coincidence.
I'd like to ask the angel you mentioned for help...
Michaela may have an answer. But, Pandora...
strings.그건 아닐 거야. 레비가 내 힘을 느꼈다면 절대 라란 가도를 떠나지 않았: No. If he sensed my power, he would never leave Laran Road.
strings.다녀오면 이야기해 줄게…. 혹시 모르니까 내가 그동안 라란 가도를 살펴보: I'll explain when you return. I'll search Laran Road in the meantime, just in case.
All right. I'll head to the Sanctuary... She's gone...
strings.(판도라가 말을 끝내자마자 흔적도 없이 사라진다. 마침 앉아서 책을 보고: (Pandora vanishes without a trace as soon as she finishes speaking. Juen, sitting nearby with a book, notices the adventurer and looks puzzled.)
I think I rushed in too quickly. I'll make proper preparations first.
strings.안이 좀 시끄럽던데…, 무슨 일 있으셨어요?: It sounded rather noisy inside... Did something happen?
strings.기계 장치가 움직이는 것 같아요. 위험하니까 안에는 절대 들어가지 말아요: The mechanisms seem to be moving. It's dangerous, so don't go inside under any circumstances.
strings.진짜요? 헤프링들은 괜찮을까요?: Really? Will the Hefrings be all right?
strings.그 녀석들은 신경 안 써도 괜찮아요. 알아서 잘 피하던데요?: Don't worry about them. They're quite good at staying out of the way.
...They can dodge on their own? How unexpected, Hefrings. Well, Adventurer, good luck with your preparations.
I'd better hurry to the Sanctuary.
strings.(모험가가 떠난 후, 헤프링이 뭔가를 봤는지 먹던 걸 멈추고 유적지 방향: (After the adventurer leaves, a Hefring stops eating and looks toward the ruins, as though spotting something.)
Hefring, what's wrong? Is something over there? I don't see anything...
strings.프리링, 너 나 보이지? 그러면 내 말 잘 들어. 이 아이를 위해 네가: Priring, you can see me, can't you? Then listen carefully. You know what you need to do here for this girl.
strings.(소년과 눈이 마주친 헤프링이 고개를 끄덕인다.): (Meeting the boy's eyes, the Hefring nods.)
strings.(쥬엔이 소년을 인식하지 못했는지 헤프링을 옆에 두고 앉아 다시 책을 읽: (Apparently unaware of the boy, Juen sits beside the Hefring and resumes reading.)
strings.(얼굴과 다리에 붕대를 감은 소년이 쥬엔과 헤프링을 뒤로 한 채 강가로: (The boy, with bandages around his face and leg, leaves Juen and the Hefring behind and walks toward the river.)
strings.나와 전투 천사가 모르는 존재가 세계에 있다니…. 역시 시간이 많이 흐른: A being in this world unknown to both me and the battle angel... A great deal of time really must have passed.
I thought escaping to the Demon Realm would be enough... only to end up trapped in the garden.
In any case, I need to know what happened while I was gone...
strings.(소년이 심호흡을 하고, 성배처럼 보이는 잔을 든다. 그러자 방금 전까지: (The boy takes a deep breath and raises a chalice-like cup. The empty vessel fills with clear water.)
O star of twisted fate, show me the memories you hold.
strings.(소년이 눈을 감은 채로 물을 마신다. 그리고 눈을 뜨고 남은 물은 바닥: (The boy closes his eyes and drinks. Then he opens them and pours the remaining water onto the ground.)
A world with almost no gods left...
strings.죽거나 도망가고, 남아있어도 제대로 있지도 않고…. 하하하하, 이거 재미: Dead or fled, and those who remain are barely present... Hahaha, how interesting.
strings.후우, 다시 정원으로 가서 헤카테의 의지로 만들어진 존재가 뭘 하는지 지: Well, I'd better return to the garden and watch what that being created by Hecate's will is doing.
strings.오랜만에 수도로 돌아가 상업지구에 갈 일이 있었는데, 도둑이 나타나 잡겠: I returned to the capital for the first time in a while and had business in the commercial district. A thief appeared, and I chased them, determined to catch them...
strings.얼마나 무리해서 다시 근신하게 된 거예요?: How badly did you overdo it to end up confined again?
strings.상대가 보통이 아니었거든요. 커다란 마도골렘을 타고 날아다니는 수인 소년: This was no ordinary thief. A beastfolk boy flying around on an enormous magic golem.
strings.그 소년을 잡으려고 하다가 그만 난장판이 됐습니다. 아르젠트가 절 붙잡고: Trying to catch him caused quite a commotion. Argent grabbed me and got angry, asking what I'd have done if I got hurt...
strings.그래도 마법청과 의회 사람들 앞에서 절 두둔해 주면서 잘 마무리 됐습니다: Still, he defended me in front of the Magic Bureau and the council, so it ended well. Though I spent half a day listening to him lecture me about leaving things to him.
strings.(아우룸이 고개를 들어 바라보자 멀리서 날아오는 미카엘라의 모습이 보인다: (Aurum looks up. Michaela can be seen flying toward them from afar. Recognizing her visitor, she approaches with a smile.)
strings.%s 와서 미카 기쁜데…, 무슨 일이야? 어, %s…. 뭐야? 이 깃털은: Mica's happy you're here, %s... What brings you? Huh, %s... What's this feather? This belongs to a battle angel...
strings.(미카엘라가 %s의 옷에 붙어있던 날개 깃털을 떼어낸다. 미카엘라의 것과: (Michaela plucks a feather from %s's clothing. It resembles her own, though it looks a little rougher.)
strings.(미카엘라에게 에기르 유적에서 전투 천사를 만난 이야기를 한다.): (I tell Michaela about meeting the battle angel in the Aegir Ruins.)
strings.(좀처럼 다른 표정을 보이지 않던 미카엘라의 눈가에 눈물이 맺힌다.): (Tears gather in Michaela's eyes, a rare change in her expression.)
strings.미카는 괜찮아. 라피가 다시 나타났단 말에 미카도 모르게 그만…. 너무: Mica's all right. Hearing that Raphie is back... I couldn't help it. I'm so happy...
I thought she vanished the day the continent was destroyed...
strings.(미카엘라가 눈물을 닦고 다른 전투 천사의 날개 깃털을 만지작거린다.): (Michaela wipes away her tears and gently handles the other battle angel's feather.)
strings.신들께서 마계로 도망가려던 뒤틀린 자를 쫓아 아틀라스 정원으로 가셨고,: The gods went to the Atlas Garden after the Twisted One, who was trying to flee to the Demon Realm. Raphie was waiting nearby...
strings.아틀라스 정원…. 미카 가본 적은 없지만, 신의 진리가 담겨 있다고 알고: The Atlas Garden... Mica's never been there, but I know it holds the gods' truth.
strings.뒤틀린 자가 무슨 일로 정원에 간 건지는 알 수 없지만 뻔해…. 진리에: I don't know why the Twisted One went there, but it's obvious... He must have meant to tamper with that truth...
strings.그곳에 간 신들께선 모두 소멸했어. 이리스 님이 마왕이라 불렀던 비스트에: Every god who went there perished. At the hands of the Beast, whom Iris called the Demon King...
strings.라피도 그런 줄 알았었는데…. 아, 이러고 있을 때가 아니지. 미카가 도: I thought Raphie had too... Oh, there's no time for this. Mica will help you.
strings.(미카엘라가 %s에게 다가가 가볍게 볼 키스를 한다.): (Michaela approaches %s and lightly kisses their cheek.)
strings.또 놀란 거야? 이제 미카에게 익숙할 때도 되지 않았어?: Again? Shouldn't you be used to Mica by now?
S-sorry. It was just so sudden...
If you spent some time confined at the Sanctuary too, %s, it wouldn't bother you at all.
Oh, Michaela? This is one of your wing feathers.
strings.전에는 미카와 싸우면 줬지만, 오늘은 그렇게 안 할게. 미카 깃털을 라피: Before, Mica gave you one after a fight. We won't do that today. Show this feather to Raphie. And call her by her real name.
I wish I could come with you, but I can't. Mica's sorry...
It's all right. I'll hurry back and tell Raphaella about you.
strings.(미카엘라가 손을 흔들며 성역 에이도스를 떠나는 모험가를 배웅한다.): (Michaela waves as the adventurer leaves Sanctuary Eidos.)
I'm glad the angel who disappeared has returned.
strings.미카도 라피가 살아 돌아온 건 기뻐…. 그런데…, 정원은 어떻게 된 거야: Mica's glad Raphie is alive too... But... what happened to the garden...?
strings.방금요. 그동안 무슨 일 없었죠? 유적 안에서 이상한 소리가 들린다거나…: Just now. Has anything happened while I was away? Strange sounds from the ruins, perhaps...?
strings.네, 그런 건 없었어요. 그런 게 있었다면 제가 여기서 편하게 책을 보고: No, nothing. If there had been, I wouldn't have been sitting here reading so comfortably.
strings.(두리번 거리는 %s의 행동에 쥬엔이 고개를 갸웃거린다.): (Juen tilts her head at %s's searching glances.)
strings.(언제 나타났는지, 판도라가 쥬엔 뒤에서 모습을 드러낸다. 그리고 %s에: (Pandora appears behind Juen without warning. She extends a hand toward %s and gestures for them to enter the Aegir Ruins.)
strings.와아…. 모험가님, 너무 멋진 거 아니신가요?!: Wow... Adventurer, could you be any cooler?!
strings.본인만의 타이밍을 체크하고 계셨던 거잖아요. 얼마나 멋진 모험을 하셨으면: You were checking for just the right moment, weren't you? What incredible adventures taught you how to do that?
So amazing. And so modest, saying it's nothing...
strings.(설명하는 게 애매하니까 빨리 가야겠다….): (Explaining this would be awkward. I'd better hurry...)
strings.혹시라도 유적지 안이 소란스러우면 빨리 마을로 가요. 알았죠? 위험해질: If you hear a commotion inside the ruins, go straight back to the village. All right? It could become dangerous.
I'm going inside now. See you later, Juen.
strings.(쥬엔이 인사하자 엎어져서 간식을 먹고 있던 헤프링도 앞발을 흔들며 인사: (As Juen says goodbye, the Hefring sprawled beside her with its snack also waves a forepaw.)
...Something about you seems a little different.
strings.성역에 계신 전투 천사님께서 방법을 알려주셨어요. 맞다. 가도를 살펴본다: The battle angel at the Sanctuary told me what to do. Oh, you said you'd search the road. Did you find anything?
strings.(판도라가 대답하려는 순간, 유적지 안에서 세찬 바람이 불어온다.): (Just as Pandora is about to answer, a powerful wind blows from within the ruins.)
The battle angel's wind again... Unlike before, it doesn't seem to affect us.
It must be because of the method you discovered.
strings.(%s 일행이 불어오는 바람을 버틴 걸 알아차렸는지, 전투 천사가 날갯짓: (Realizing that %s and Pandora have withstood the wind, the battle angel flies toward them.)
Mica? You're not Mica... How do you have Mica's power...?
Raphaella, please listen. I have something to tell you.
strings.네 손에 있는 미카의 깃털이 뭘 의미하는지는 알고 있어. 하지만, 라피는: I know what Mica's feather in your hand means. But Raphie still can't accept it.
So fight Raphie once more. Let me see for myself...
strings.미카와 라피 같은 전투 천사의 방법이니까. 그리고 여기선 안 돼. 여기서: That's how battle angels like Mica and Raphie do things. But not here. If our powers clash here, the magic gathered in this place will explode.
That's the sort of place this is. It's too close to the garden...
strings.알았어요. 그러면 어디로 가면 돼요?: All right. Where should I go?
strings.전에 나하고 싸웠던 곳 알지? 거기가 넓고 제일 깊은 곳이니까 거기로 와: Remember where we fought before? It's the widest, deepest part of the ruins. Come there. I'll go ahead and wait.
(At %s's nod, Raphaella quickly flies deeper inside.)
This has become troublesome, but I'll help you.
strings.아니에요. 제가 할게요. 미카엘라 님의 깃털을 가지고 있는 제가 라파엘라: No, I'll do it. I have Michaela's feather, so I need to fight Raphaella myself.
She said that's the battle angels' way...
Understood. If that's their way... I'll lead us there, then.
strings.(전투 천사와 눈이 마주치는 순간, 날카로운 공격이 %s에게 날아온다.): (The moment their eyes meet, the battle angel launches a sharp attack at %s.)
strings.(혼신을 다한 라파엘라와 %s의 공격이 맞부딪히면서 유적지 안에 있는 모: (Raphaella and %s clash with all their strength, shaking everything within the ruins.)
Somehow, I've ended up watching servants of the gods fight each other.
strings.(길어지는 전투에 전투 천사 라파엘라의 얼굴에 조금씩 지친 기색이 보인다: (As the battle drags on, fatigue begins to show on Raphaella's face. While she pauses for breath, %s launches a powerful attack.)
strings.(전투 천사 라파엘라가 %s의 공격을 막긴 했지만, 힘이 모두 빠졌는지: (Raphaella blocks %s's attack, but her strength gives out and she falls backward.)
Yes, I'm fine. I'm just too worn out to stand. Give me your hand.
strings.(라파엘라가 환한 웃음과 함께 %s의 손을 붙잡고 자리에서 일어난다.): (With a bright smile, Raphaella takes %s's hand and rises.)
strings.다시 한번 말하지만, 라피는 괜찮아. 너 미카가 좋다고 한 사람이니까 라: I told you, Raphie's fine. Mica likes you, so I must have misunderstood. Now, give Raphie Mica's feather.
strings.라파엘라 님, 이제 이름을 불러드리면 되죠?: Now I should say your name, right, Raphaella?
You've already said my name. There's one other thing.
strings.(라파엘라가 %s의 곁으로 다가가가 미카엘라처럼 볼키스를 한다.): (Raphaella approaches %s and kisses their cheek, just as Michaela did.)
strings.후우, 익숙해지려면 얼마나 더 해야 하는 거지…?: Sigh... How many more times before I get used to that...?
You're popular with angels... Anyway, Raphie? Raphaella? Battle angel... I have a question.
strings.너 마족 같긴 하지만, 라피가 일단 널 미카의 친구의 친구처럼 생각하면: You seem like a demon, but should Raphie think of you as a friend of Mica's friend for now?
strings.친구의 친구? 뭐, 비슷해…. 너는 왜 여기에 있는 거지?: A friend of a friend? Something like that... Why are you here?
Raphie was ordered to wait here before going to the Atlas Garden.
Oh, I need to explain that... Raphaella, listen carefully.
strings.라파엘라 님과 미카엘라 님은 서로 못 본 지 오래됐어요. 천 년? 아니면: It's been a very long time since you and Michaela last saw each other. A thousand years? Perhaps more...
No. Just a few days ago...
strings.(라파엘라가 뭔가 깨달았는지 고개를 푹 숙인다.): (Raphaella lowers her head, apparently realizing something.)
That explains it... Something felt strange. There used to be nothing by the river here.
strings.아틀라스 정원 주위에서 힘을 숨긴 뒤틀린 자를 쫓고 있다가 이 근처에서: We were pursuing the Twisted One, who had concealed his power near the Atlas Garden. I was resting nearby...
And I heard a god scream...
It was such a terrible sound that Raphie thought it was a dream...
strings.차라리 꿈이 나을지도 몰라. 아무리 밖으로 나가려고 해도 나갈 수 없었으: Perhaps a dream would have been better. No matter how hard I tried, I couldn't get out.
Then I saw you two. I thought you were the ones keeping me here.
strings.라피 바보 같지? 신을 지켜야 하는 전투 천사가 신의 비명을 듣고도 꿈으: Raphie's a fool, isn't she? A battle angel meant to protect the gods, wanting to believe their screams were only a dream...
I'd never heard a god scream like that...
strings.(슬퍼하고 있던 라파엘라의 곁으로 언제 나타났는지 작은 빛의 구가 다가와: (A small orb of light appears beside the grieving Raphaella and begins circling her.)
strings.(라파엘라가 다가오는 작은 빛을 두 손에 받는 순간, 그를 위로하는 작은: (The moment Raphaella cups the little light in her hands, a soft, comforting voice rings out.)
Lady Seres...? No. That isn't Lady Seres's voice.
strings.라파엘라 님, 이 목소리는 세레스 님의 뒤를 이어 성계신이 된 이리스예요: Raphaella, this is Iris. She succeeded Seres as God of the Astral Realm.
What about Lady Seres? Lady Seres...
strings.미안해요, 라파엘라…. 길게 설명할 시간이 없어서 대신 위대한 벽에 닿은: I'm sorry, Raphaella... There's no time for a long explanation. Instead, I'll give you some of the world's memories that reached the Great Wall.
(At Iris's words, the light rises from Raphaella's cupped hands and circles her as though wrapping her in an embrace.)
Oh... Oh... So much happened while Raphie was gone...
Lady Seres, Lady Gaia... Lady Iris...
strings.(라파엘라가 랜스를 붙잡은 채로 아이같이 펑펑 운다. 그런 라파엘라를 위: (Clutching her lance, Raphaella weeps like a child. The little light circles her comfortingly, then comes to rest at her side.)
strings.이리스…. 이제 라파엘라 님은 어떻게 되는 거야?: Iris... What will happen to Raphaella now?
strings.지금 전투 천사 두 분은 강한 운명으로 계신 땅에 묶여 있어요…. 미카엘: Both battle angels are bound to their lands by powerful fates... Michaela to the Sanctuary, and Raphaella to the area around the Aegir Ruins...
strings.그건 아니에요. 지금 바로 여기서 나갈 수 있는 건 아니지만, 약속할게요: That isn't quite it. You can't leave immediately, but I promise I'll find a way for you to meet Michaela at the Sanctuary.
strings.이리스 님, 고마워요! 라피 기다릴 수 있어요!: Thank you, Lady Iris! Raphie can wait!
I'm the one who's grateful. And...
strings.데르족의 아이가 이렇게 될 줄은 그때는 상상도 못 했는데…. 인사는 나중: I never imagined that child of the Tyr would become this... We can exchange greetings later.
strings.라파엘라, %s…. 이제 이 빛은 금방 사라질 거예요. 급하게 해서 제대: Raphaella, %s... This light will fade soon. I acted in haste and couldn't prepare it properly.
It's all right. Once we find Levi... Ah...
strings.(%s의 말이 끝나기도 전에 라파엘라의 손에 있던 작은 빛은 그대로 증발: (Before %s can finish, the little light in Raphaella's hands evaporates.)
...Oh, I wanted to talk a little longer...
strings.천사, 나와 %s, 둘 말고 다른 사람 본 적 없어?: Angel, have you seen anyone besides %s and me?
strings.라피는 다른 사람은 보질 못했어…. 어?: Raphie hasn't seen anyone else... Oh?
strings.본 사람은 없지만, 매우 강한 힘이 느껴져서 몸을 숨긴 적은 있어. 너희: I didn't see anyone, but I once hid after sensing an extremely powerful presence. Different from the energy you two have...
strings.마족도 아니고, 신의 가호를 받은 것도 아닌 힘이었어. 그런 힘이 바로: It wasn't demonic power or a god's blessing. It vanished at once, so I went to look and found this lying there.
strings.(판도라가 라파엘라에게서 받은 물건을 보고 놀란다.): (Pandora startles at the object Raphaella gives her.)
I think I saw that when I visited Poe Mansion...
strings.그대와 싸우기 전까지만 해도 여기에 나쁜 기운을 담았었어. 하지만, 지금: Until my battle with you, I kept sinister energy inside this. But not anymore. Now it's only an empty box...
Why did Levi have this...? Where could he have gone...? Levi...
I can't. In this situation, all I can do is...
I'll help you. That's why I'm here.
strings.(판도라가 뭔가 말하려는 순간, 조용했던 에기르 유적이 흔들리기 시작한다: (Just as Pandora is about to speak, the quiet Aegir Ruins begin to shake.)
strings.라피가 나가서 확인해 볼게. 이리스 님이 유적지 근처라면 괜찮다고 했으니: Raphie will go outside and check. Lady Iris said staying near the ruins would be all right.
(Raphaella beats her wings hard and flies toward the exit. But she strikes something and is hurled back inside.)
strings.(라파엘라가 다시 한번 밖으로 향해 날아가려고 하는 순간, 갑자기 바닥으: (Just as Raphaella tries to fly outside again, she suddenly drops to the ground.)
strings.아틀라스 정원이 보였어. 거기서 뒤틀린 자의 힘과 다른 힘이 섞여서 요동: I saw the Atlas Garden. The Twisted One's power is surging there, mixed with another force... It's keeping Raphie from approaching...
strings.라파엘라 님은 여기 계세요. 판도라, 저에게 할 말 있죠?: Stay here, Raphaella. Pandora, you have something to tell me, don't you?
We need to go and see.
strings.미카엘라 님에게 설명 들었어요. 일단 밖에서 어떻게 된 건지 확인해 볼: Michaela told me about it. I'll check what's happening outside. Rest here in the meantime, Raphaella.
strings.여긴 괜찮은 거겠죠?: You'll be all right here, won't you?
strings.회복할 수 있을 것 같아…. 라피, 여기서 쉬고 있을게. 미안해. 도움이: I think I can recover... Raphie will rest here. I'm sorry I couldn't help...
strings.(라파엘라가 그대로 눈을 감은 채 잠이 든다.): (Raphaella closes her eyes and falls asleep.)
%s, follow me. There's something I need to do there. Oh...
strings.먼저 그대가 할 일이 있어. 유적지 앞에 있는 아이에게 마을로 돌아가라고: First, there's something you should do. Tell the girl outside the ruins to return to the village.
strings.알겠어요. 그런데 어디로 가시는데요?: All right. But where are you going?
The clearing where we met Daphne.
strings.(판도라가 할 말을 끝내고 서둘러 유적 출구를 향해 걸어간다.): (Having finished speaking, Pandora hurries toward the ruins' exit.)
strings.라파엘라 님이 말한 정원…, 역시 눈으로 확인해 보는 수밖에 없겠지…?: The garden Raphaella mentioned... I suppose I have to see it for myself...
strings.그렇다는 건 뭔가 또 남아있다는 거죠?: That means there's something left, doesn't it?
There is, but you mustn't go inside, Juen. It's still full of dangers.
strings.그렇게까지 말씀하시니 더 궁금해지지만, 모험가님 말씀대로 몇 년간은 유적: That only makes me more curious, but I'll do as you say. I won't go into the ruins for at least a few years.
I can gain experience later. It doesn't have to be now.
Oh, Juen. I have a favor to ask.
Please don't ask why right now. I'd like you to go straight back to the village.
strings.대신 일을 모두 끝내고 제가 마을로 돌아오면 쥬엔에게 재미있는 이야기를: In return, once everything's finished and I'm back in the village, I'll tell you some interesting stories.
About traveling through Eastland and meeting the Champions...
I'll give you a souvenir from Eastland too.
strings.모, 모험가님, 멋져요. 완전 최고예요. 저, 저 그러면 바로 집으로 갈: A-Adventurer, you're amazing! The absolute best! I'll go straight home, then. Promise.
strings.우와아, 헤프링! 들었지? 들었지?: Woooow, Hefring! Did you hear that? Did you?
strings.(헤프링이 전혀 모르겠다는 표정으로 쥬엔을 바라보다 다시 엎어진다.): (The Hefring gives Juen a completely uncomprehending look, then flops down again.)
Hehe. Adventurer, get everything sorted out and come straight to our house. All right?
strings.(쥬엔이 환한 미소와 함께 빠른 걸음으로 마을로 향한다.): (Juen heads briskly toward the village with a bright smile.)
strings.저기 하늘에 있는 거 뭐지? 여기 처음 올 때는 보이지 않았었는데…. 그: What's that in the sky? It wasn't there when I first came... Then that must be...
strings.안 되겠어. 판도라가 있는 곳으로 빨리 가야 해. 이번에도 마을이 위험해: I'd better hurry to Pandora. I hope this doesn't put another village in danger...
strings.(판도라가 공터에서 하늘을 바라보다가 다가오는 %s의 모습에 쓴웃음을 짓: (Pandora looks up at the sky from the clearing, then gives %s a bitter smile as they approach.)
I suddenly feel as though I'm being used...
Someone who wants to move me, you, and everyone in this world like pieces on a chessboard...
strings.날 믿고 도와준 그대에게 내 이야기를 하려고 해. 들어주겠어?: You trusted me and helped me. I want to tell you my story. Will you listen?
strings.(%s의 대답과 함께 판도라와 %s의 주위에 어둠이 몰려온다.): (At %s's reply, darkness gathers around Pandora and %s.)
These shadows won't affect you. There's no need to be afraid.
strings.(판도라가 가볍게 웃자 두 사람을 감싸고 있던 그림자가 점점 짙어져 소리: (Pandora smiles softly. The shadows surrounding them deepen until only their voices remain.)
strings.마녀에 관한 이야기, 레비에 관한 이야기…, 그리고 내가 밤에 다가가려는: About the witches, about Levi... and why I'm approaching the night. Which would you like to hear first?
As you know, I am an Agasura.
strings.아가슈라의 대부분은 죄인이라 불리는 족속들. 죄를 지어 죽는 죄인들은 그: Most Agasuras are those called sinners. Those who die for their sins wish simply to die, but some cannot. They become beings condemned to keep committing those same sins.
strings.그대가 알고 있는 모든 죄인들이 그렇다. 나도 그렇고…. 무슨 죄인지 이: Every sinner you know is like that. Myself included... What my sin was can wait for another time.
strings.영원히 죄를 지어야만 살 수 있는 존재. 다시 태어나는 것조차 허락되지: Beings who can only live by sinning eternally. We are not even permitted to be reborn. To end this life, we must grant another's wish and vanish...
strings.난 아가슈라가 된 순간부터 오래 머무르고 싶지 않았어. 그래서 사라지려고: From the moment I became an Agasura, I wanted my existence to be brief. I tried to disappear, but at some point, another fate took hold of me.
A witch's life, compelled to approach the night...
strings.에트와르의 신들은 생명에 개입할 힘이 있지만, 직접적으로 건드리지 않았다: The gods of Etoile had the power to interfere with life, but did not tamper with it directly. Yet the Goddess of the Black Moon...
strings.그대의 입에서 헤카테의 이름이 흘러 나오다니…. 이미 만났겠군. 그래,: To hear Hecate's name from your lips... You have met her. Well, if you've met Daphne, I suppose I should have guessed you knew Hecate too.
strings.그래, 헤카테가 나를 비롯해 많은 자들의 운명에 손을 댔다. 신의 힘이: Yes. Hecate meddled with my fate and those of many others. A god's power might have been a blessing, but this was a curse.
strings.서로 죽고 죽이고 그 안에서 살아남는 것…. 저주받은 자들이 저주에서 벗: To kill and be killed, and survive amid it all... We who were cursed had to survive to escape the curse...
strings.그래서 내가 그대에게 관여하지 말라고 했었지? 관여한 존재들은 모두 죽었: That's why I told you not to get involved. Everyone who became involved died...
strings.판도라, 그래서 만일이지만…. 만일이지만…. 최후의 마녀만 남게 된다면: Pandora, suppose... just suppose... only one witch were left. What would happen?
strings.아직 다 죽지 않아서 잘 모르겠지만, 신에 가까운 존재가 되겠지. 죽은: They haven't all died yet, so I can't be certain. But she would likely become something close to a god. A slain witch's abilities pass to her killer...
strings.모르가나의 능력이 다프네에게 갔던 것도…. 아, 그러면 판도라의 능력은…: That's why Morgana's power went to Daphne... Oh, then your ability...
None of the witches wants my ability. It is the life of an Agasura itself...
strings.그렇다고 해서 내가 최후의 마녀가 될 생각은 없어. 그런 건 레비가 원하: Even so, I have no intention of becoming the last witch. Levi would never want that...
strings.(레비에 관한 이야기를 들으려 하자 판도라가 잠시 머뭇거린다. 하지만,: (When the adventurer asks about Levi, Pandora hesitates. Then she begins, apparently determined to explain properly.)
strings.다른 아가슈라의 일원들이 나쁜 일을 하기 위해 대륙 전역으로 다닌 것과: Unlike the other Agasuras, who traveled across the continents doing evil, I always stayed in the mansion.
strings.굳이 찾아다니면서 죄를 만드는 짓은 하고 싶지 않았으니까. 그러다 죄를: I didn't want to go out of my way to create sins. Then I found the perfect place for a witch fated to sin.
strings.포우 저택…. 마법사 앨런이 남긴 수상한 저택. 관 속에서 잠들어 있던: Poe Mansion... The strange estate left behind by the mage Allen. Vampanella awoke from his coffin and volunteered to serve me.
strings.그리고 소문을 내서 많은 사람을 끌어들였어. 고딕 룸에서 위대한 마녀를: We spread rumors to draw people in. Meet the great witch in the Gothic Room, and she would grant your wish...
strings.그런대로 괜찮은 선택이었어. 밤파넬라에겐 피가 필요했고, 나는 아가슈라였: It was a reasonable arrangement. Vampanella needed blood, and I was an Agasura.
strings.시시한 소원을 빌러 왔던 자들은 소원을 빌기도 전에 고딕 룸 앞에서 죽어: Those who came with petty wishes died before they could even make them, outside the Gothic Room. I thought them weak. Full of greed, and nothing more...
strings.그러던 어느 날. 한 남자가 피를 흘린 채로 고딕 룸 앞에 도착했어. 날: Then one day, a man reached the Gothic Room covered in blood. Anyone strong enough to reach me interested me.
On the threshold of death, that young man held out a baby to me.
strings.아이가 살 날이 얼마 남지 앉았소, 내 목숨을 줄 테니 제발 아이를 살려: He cried, "My child doesn't have long to live. Take my life, but please save him."
strings.사실 사람들의 어떤 소원에도 흥미가 없었지만, 그때는 달랐어. 잠에서 깨: People's wishes had never interested me before. But this time was different. The baby awoke, looked at his father, and laughed. That sound captivated me.
strings.나는 청년에게 이야기했어. 아이와 당신의 영혼을 달라고. 청년은 망설였지: I told the man I wanted his soul and the child's. He hesitated, then agreed, on the condition that I take them only when their lives reached their natural end.
That was fine with me. I had no use for their souls anyway.
strings.하지만, 청년은 다른 곳에서 망설였어. 아이가 다시 사는 대신, 깊은 감: But something else made him hesitate. He couldn't bear the thought that, in return for living, his child would lose his deep emotions and radiant smile.
strings.청년은 어떻게든 아이를 살리고 싶었겠지. 결국 자기 손으로 결정할 수밖에: Still, he wanted his child to live, whatever the cost. In the end, he had to make the choice himself.
strings.아이의 미소가 사라지던 중에 난 뭔가 알게 됐지만, 별거 아닐 거라 생각: As the baby's smile faded, I realized something. But I dismissed it as unimportant.
strings.그렇게 아기는 살아났고, 약속대로 깊은 감정을 잃게 됐어. 더는 울지 않: And so the baby lived, losing his deep emotions as agreed. He became a child who no longer cried.
That is the story of Levi and his father, Lian...
strings.아렌스 부자는 나와 계약으로 묶였지만, 그걸 저주라 생각하지 않았던 것: The Arens father and son were bound to me by a contract, but I don't think they saw it as a curse. Perhaps that was only my interpretation...
strings.뭐가 그렇게 고마운 건지 계속해서 날 찾아왔어. 나는 그렇게 레비가 자라: For some reason, they were so grateful that they kept visiting me. And so I watched Levi grow up.
strings.그러던 어느 날, 레비가 날 찾아와 이렇게 이야기했어. 데르 족의 소녀와: Then one day, Levi came and told me he was going on a journey with a girl of the Tyr to find the Demon King...
strings.아가슈라는 본능적으로 이리스를 알고 있어. 죄를 지은 자들이 더는 죄를: Agasuras know Iris instinctively. She is the sole survivor of a sacred people with the power to stop sinners from sinning again.
strings.그래서 아가슈라인 내가 새로운 성계신의 심판을 당장 받아도 이상하지 않아: So it would be no surprise if the new God of the Astral Realm passed judgment on an Agasura like me this very moment. I don't know how many of the Tyr died by my hand...
But before that, there's something I must do. That is why I'm approaching the night.
strings.(판도라가 고개를 들어 하늘을 바라본다.): (Pandora raises her head toward the sky.)
strings.레비가 떠나고 나는 한동안 이상한 기분에 사로잡혔어. 그게 뭔지 알 수: After Levi left, a strange feeling gripped me for a while. I didn't understand it at first, but I soon learned.
Levi had been killed by the Demon King...
strings.그제야 깨달았어. 아가슈라와 관련된 힘이 모두 마왕에게로 흘러 들어간다는: Only then did I realize that all power tied to the Agasuras flowed into the Demon King... Everything, including Levi's soul bound to me...
strings.이해하기 힘들 거야. 지금 나도 마왕 따위 없는 이 세계가 복잡하다고 느: It must be difficult to understand. Even I find this world, now without a Demon King, bewildering.
strings.그런데, 레비가 다시 돌아왔어. 영혼도 육체도 소멸하지 않은 채로 말이지: But Levi returned. Neither his soul nor his body had been destroyed...
strings.비스트가 마왕이란 모습으로 다시 태어났던 건 완벽한 데르족의 영혼과 융합: The Beast was reborn as the Demon King because it merged with a complete soul of the Tyr.
strings.레비가 아팠던 건, 마왕에게 영혼이 흡수되지 않았던 건…. 불완전한 영혼: Levi was ill, and his soul wasn't absorbed by the Demon King... because it was incomplete.
This... This makes no sense. How could something like this happen...?
strings.(요동치는 감정을 겨우 가라앉힌 채 판도라에게 힐다와 있었던 이야기를 꺼: (Barely calming my surging emotions, I tell Pandora what happened with Hilda.)
strings.저 위의 존재들은 이 세계의 생명에게 지겨울 정도로 지독한 괴로움을 주는: Those beings above inflict such relentless, cruel suffering on the lives of this world.
strings.레비도 비슷한 색을 가지고 있는 영혼의 소유자를 만나면 무너지겠지. 그리: If Levi meets someone whose soul has a similar color, he too will crumble. And so will I, bound to him by contract...
strings.내가 리안과 레비의 영혼에 손댄 순간부터 이미 저 위의 존재들 뜻대로 움: From the moment I touched Lian's and Levi's souls, I was already acting according to those beings' will...
The transcendent being who sent me to this place...
strings.난 그 자에게 레비를 잃고 싶지 않아. 그래서 레비의 영혼을 완벽하게 만: I won't lose Levi to that being. So I'll make his soul complete.
Restore his emotions, and let him live fully as a human...
strings.영혼을 융합하는 능력의 마녀를 찾아 죽이고 그 능력을 받으면 되지만…,: I could find and kill a witch with the power to merge souls, then take that ability... But I will find another way.
I will never use methods Levi would hate...
strings.아, 아낀다기보다는 계약으로 이어져 있는 관계니까 나, 난 계약을 지켜야: I-it isn't that I care. We're bound by a contract, so I... I have to honor it...
Protecting Levi is only natural as his contract holder...
I understand. No need to get flustered.
strings.하여튼 그래서 내가 원하는 방법이 저곳에 있는 것 같아. 추악한 세계의: Anyway, I believe the means I seek lies there. Concealing the truth of this hideous world...
strings.(하늘을 바라보던 판도라가 조용히 %s에게 손짓한다.): (Pandora looks up at the sky, then quietly gestures to %s.)
strings.누가 처음부터 이곳에 있었군. 내가 그대와 대화하는 동안 전혀 알아차리지: Someone has been here from the start. To think I never noticed while we spoke...
I need to see who's there...
strings.(판도라의 손짓으로 주위에 펼쳐진 어둠이 사라진다. 그리고 그 사이에서: (At Pandora's gesture, the surrounding darkness vanishes. An unexpected figure appears, looking distressed.)
I'm an inspector of the Jiendia Empire. Levi...
strings.(감찰사 레비의 이름을 들은 판도라의 얼굴이 잔뜩 굳어진다.): (Pandora's face hardens at the name Inspector Levi.)
strings.그 이름 대신 다른 이름을 대라!!: Give me a name other than that one!!
Y-yes? Other than Levi... Ah... T-Tation.
Very well, Tation. Tell me why you're here.
strings.제국의 요청이 있어서 제가 먼저 글래스턴으로 가던 중이었습니다. 그런데,: The Empire sent a request, so I was heading ahead to Glaston. Then a woman with rabbit ears suddenly appeared and asked if I would be her servant...
When I asked what she meant, she said she was joking, then made me unable to move. I don't remember much after that...
strings.눈을 떠 보니 이곳이었습니다. 두 분께서 대화하고 계셔서 살려달라고 외쳤: When I opened my eyes, I was here. You two were talking. I called for help, but you couldn't hear me...
strings.(분노를 머금은 판도라의 목소리가 공터를 뒤흔든다. 그러자 주위를 감싸고: (Pandora's furious voice shakes the clearing. The surrounding scenery shatters like glass, its pieces falling to the ground one by one.)
strings.(조각이 전부 떨어지고 난 후, 그 뒤에서 토끼 귀를 쫑긋거리는 여성이: (Once every fragment has fallen, a smiling woman with twitching rabbit ears appears behind them.)
You truly are no ordinary witch. Pandora the Agasura.
strings.(다프네가 쓰러진 테이션을 안쓰러운 표정으로 바라본다. 그러나 적의가 가: (Daphne looks at the fallen Tation with pity. But when a hostile weapon is aimed at her, she turns her gaze to %s.)
strings.제가 당신에게 말한 적 있지 않나요? 여기선 당신에게 볼일이 없다고. 후: Haven't I told you? I have no business with you here. Hehe.
strings.(다프네가 지팡이 끝으로 %s의 무기를 밀어낸다.): (Daphne pushes %s's weapon aside with the tip of her staff.)
Pandora, I'd like to hear your answer.
First, tell me what you've done with Levi.
strings.당신이 찾는 사람은 저 위, 하늘 위에 떠있는 아틀라스 정원을 헤매고 있: The person you seek is wandering the Atlas Garden floating above us. He believes you're there.
strings.그러면 제 이야길 하죠, 판도라…. 나는 당신이 필요해요. 우리, 함께: Now, let me speak, Pandora... I need you. Let us welcome the night together.
strings.선물로 이 자를 드릴 테니 제게 오세요. 당신이 아끼는 레비를 위해. 그: I'll give you this man as a gift. Come to me, for the sake of your precious Levi. As though their souls had always been one...
I won't do that. I won't do anything Levi would not want.
So you intend to open the box in the garden.
strings.어쩔 수 없죠. 덕분에 귀찮지만 일 하나를 드릴게요. %s, 당신에게도: Very well. It's troublesome, but I'll give you another task. A new task for you too, %s.
strings.(다프네가 들고 있던 지팡이를 두드리자, 뒤쪽에서 흐르던 아이사르 강에서: (Daphne taps her staff. Enormous droplets leap from the Isar River behind her.)
strings.(물방울이 쓰러져 있는 테이션을 감싸 안고서 하늘 위로 올라간다.): (The droplets enclose the fallen Tation and rise into the sky.)
strings.(다프네가 하늘 위로 날아가는 테이션을 만족스럽게 바라보다가 천천히 물러: (Daphne watches him ascend with satisfaction, then slowly retreats.)
strings.같은 색의 영혼을 가진 자들이 이제 곧 만날 거예요, 판도라. 결과는 말: Those whose souls share a color will soon meet, Pandora. I needn't tell you the result, do I?
The one with the weaker soul will die.
Now, everyone. Come to the garden.
strings.(그 말을 끝으로 다프네가 공터에서 흔적도 없이 사라진다.): (With those words, Daphne vanishes from the clearing without a trace.)
strings.(다프네가 사라지자, 공터를 감싸고 있던 불안한 기운도 온데간데 없어진다: (As Daphne disappears, the uneasy presence surrounding the clearing vanishes as well.)
She must have intended this from the start.
strings.%s, 빨리 정원으로 가야겠어…. 처음부터 갈 생각이긴 했지만 이제 망설: %s, we need to reach the garden quickly... I meant to go there anyway, but now there's no reason to hesitate.
strings.그런데 알고 싶은 게 있어요. 정원에 있는 상자란 건 뭐죠?: There's something I want to know first. What is the box in the garden?
Records the gods left about life and souls.
strings.(판도라가 %s의 질문에 답을 하자마자 서둘러 공터를 빠져나간다.): (No sooner has Pandora answered %s's question than she hurries out of the clearing.)
strings.(그러면 그게 신들의 유산이란 건데…. 이대로 찾아도 괜찮은 건가?): (Then it's a legacy of the gods... Is it all right for us to seek it out like this?)
strings.(그거보다 사람들을 구하는 게 먼저야…. 다들, 조금만 기다려요….): (Saving those people comes first... Everyone, just hold on...)
strings.(판도라 앞에 커다란 물방울이 떠올라 요동치고 있다.): (An enormous droplet floats before Pandora, pulsing with energy.)
Pandora, there you are. Is this...?
strings.맞아. 아틀라스 정원으로 가는 문. 아이사르 강이 엄청난 마력을 품고 있: Yes. A door to the Atlas Garden. The garden seems to be the reason the Isar River held so much magic.
Face this droplet, beating like a heart, and we should reach the garden.
Come. To the garden of the gods...
strings.(판도라가 손을 뻗자 요동치던 물방울을 마치 기다리고 있었던 것처럼 펼쳐: (Pandora reaches out. The pulsing droplet opens as though it has been waiting, swallowing the two travelers bound for a place they were never invited to enter.)
strings.(두 사람을 감싼 물방울이 흩어지면서 진풍경이 눈 앞에 펼쳐진다.): (The water surrounding them disperses, revealing a remarkable sight.)
strings.(예스럽지 않은 건물에 풍차처럼 생긴 구조물이 붙어 움직이고 있다. 그: (A structure resembling a windmill turns on a building that looks far from ancient. Beneath it, a vast reservoir supports everything.)
Incredible. I never imagined a place like this...
strings.이런 걸로 신기해 하다니…. 아직 멀었군. 세계는 네가 알지 못하는 부분: If this amazes you, you still have far to go... There is more of the world you don't know than you do. It is larger and deeper than you imagine.
Beyond cool... It's cold here. What did the gods leave in this place?
strings.(주위를 둘러보고 있던 %s의 시야에 멀리 누군가 다가오는 모습이 보인다: (As %s looks around, a figure approaches from the distance.)
strings.(얼굴과 다리에 붕대를 감은 소년이 반가운 표정으로 %s의 곁으로 달려온: (A boy with bandages around his face and leg runs toward %s, looking pleased.)
He is no ordinary person. Be careful.
strings.반가워. 안 그래도 기다리고 있었어. 이곳은 아틀라스 정원. 신들의 진리: Welcome. I've been waiting for you. This is the Atlas Garden, where the gods' truth resides.
strings.흠, 사실 아는 사람만 아는 곳이긴 하지만. 아, 사람이 아니고 신만 아: Well, only those in the know are aware of it. Oh, not people. Only gods.
Like it or not, only those connected to the gods can come here.
strings.신의 가호를 받은 너 같은 사람이나 신의 장난으로 쓸데없는 운명을 받은: People blessed by gods, like you. Or witches saddled with pointless fates by a god's games...
Though technically, you're just a remnant of the Beast that devoured the gods.
strings.아차, 나는 너희들을 알고 있지만, 너희들은 나를 모르니 알려줘야겠지?: Oh, right. I know you, but you don't know me. I should introduce myself.
Witch, say the name that comes to your mind.
strings.(자, 잠깐. 이건…. 헤카테를 만났던 때와 비슷하잖아. 하지만, 그때보: (W-wait. This is... like when I met Hecate. But I don't feel as much power as I did then.)
