strings.내 이름은 메노이티. 간단하게 메노라고 불러. 이티라고 부르면 화낼 거야: My name is Menoiti. Call me Meno for short. Call me Iti, and I'll get angry.
...Telling me to speak the name that comes to mind. You're a god.
strings.그래. 오래전에 난 신이란 이름으로 불렸어. 어쩌다 보니 뒤틀린 자로 다: Yes. Long ago, I was called a god. Somehow, I ended up being called the Twisted One instead.
strings.신이고 인간이고 모든 게 다 마음에 들 수 없잖아. 딱 몇 번 싫다고 한: Gods or humans, no one can like everything. I only said no a few times... Sigh.
strings.세상에 예쁜 이름도 많은데, 뭐가 뒤틀렸다고 하는 거야. 잘 봐. 이렇게: There are so many lovely names in the world. What exactly is twisted about me? Look closely. Does someone this pretty look twisted to you?
strings.메노, 그래서 우리를 어떻게 할 거지?: Meno, what are you going to do to us?
strings.내가 명색이 뒤틀린 자니까 뭐라도 할 거라 생각한 거야? 후후, 정답이야: Did you think someone called the Twisted One must be up to something? Hehe. Correct.
strings.친구들이 잡아먹히거나 도망간 세계에서 오랜만에 깨어났는데, 할 수 있는: I've awakened after so long in a world where my friends were eaten or fled. Shouldn't I try everything I can?
strings.헤카테의 저주로 태어난 비스트의 찌꺼기. 아, 이렇게 부르는 거 엄청나게: A remnant of the Beast born from Hecate's curse... Oh, that's far too long. I'll just call you a witch. Pandora the Witch.
strings.네가 찾는 게 이곳에 있긴 해. 그런데 어쩌지? 아틀라스 정원이 깨어나면: What you're looking for is here. But there's a problem. When the Atlas Garden awoke, its gardener awoke too.
strings.정원사 메테우스는 세계의 진리와 영혼을 탐하는 게 누구라도 베어버려. 그: Metheus the gardener cuts down anyone who covets the world's truth and souls. Even a god who gave it its sharp edges.
strings.신들조차 죽여버릴 정도로 숨기고 싶었던 진리란 대체 무엇일까? 궁금하지: What truth did they want to hide so badly that they'd kill even gods for it? Aren't you curious?
strings.그때 난 목숨 걸고 그걸 찾아내 마계로 가려고 했어. 비스트에게 죽을 바: Back then, I risked my life trying to find it and flee to the Demon Realm. It was safer there than being killed by the Beast.
strings.나 하나 잡겠다고 전투 천사와 세인트 발키리들을 다 끌고 왔다니까. 게다: They brought battle angels and Saint Valkyries just to catch me. And the gardener was rampaging too.
Well... That all failed. So now I'm giving up on truth and everything else, and just enjoying life. The gardener must have realized I've quit, because it leaves me alone.
strings.비스트도 없고, 날 죽일 존재도 없는데 아등바등 살 필요도 없고. 나 욕: The Beast is gone, and there's no one left to kill me. No need to struggle. I won't be greedy.
But while you're here, I'll play a few tricks beside the gardener. Do forgive me.
strings.(메노이티가 혼잣말을 끝내고 성배처럼 보이는 잔을 높이 든다. 그러자 조: (Finishing his monologue, Menoiti raises his chalice. The vessel, empty only a moment ago, fills with clear water.)
O star bearing the fate of destruction, beloved and praised by all.
strings.(메노이티의 말이 이어질수록 잔에 있던 물이 요동치면서 용의 형상으로 변: (As Menoiti continues, the water in his cup surges and takes the shape of a dragon.)
strings.(판도라와 %s에게 몸이 굳는 것 같은 공포가 다가오다가 이내 풀리고 만: (A paralyzing terror settles over Pandora and %s, then suddenly releases them.)
Oh... What came next? Ah, I can't remember.
strings.(메노이티가 피식 웃으며 방금 전까지도 잔 안에서 요동치던 물을 그대로: (Menoiti chuckles and drinks the water that was surging in his cup only moments ago.)
I'll keep my games mild today, then head back. So don't hate me too much.
strings.(메노이티가 마시고 남은 물을 바닥에 흘린다. 그러자, 바닥에서 튀어 오: (Menoiti spills the remaining water onto the ground. Droplets leap up, surround him, and vanish with him inside.)
strings.작정하고 방해할 셈이군. 레비…, 레비?: He's determined to interfere. Levi... Levi?
I can sense Levi over there. That way.
strings.(판도라가 한곳을 바라보고 있을 때, 멀리서 레비인 것 같은 목소리가 들: (As Pandora looks in one direction, a voice resembling Levi's comes from the distance.)
strings.「판도라 님, 절 위한다는 믿음으로 나쁜 선택은 하지 마시길….」: 「Lady Pandora, please don't make the wrong choice believing it's for my sake...」
strings.틀림없어. 레비의 목소리야. 어떻게 여기까지 들려오는 거지? 설마 다프네: There's no mistaking it. It's Levi. How can we hear him from here? Could Daphne...?
strings.(판도라가 흔들리는 눈빛으로 서둘러 앞으로 나아간다. 뭐라 말할 틈도 없: (With uncertainty in her eyes, Pandora rushes ahead. Before %s can say anything, she is already moving, and they hurry after her.)
strings.(아틀라스 정원에 있는 모든 길과 구조물을 확인하는 동안, 뒤틀린 자를: (While checking every path and structure in the Atlas Garden, they are constantly pursued by its inhabitants, including the Twisted One.)
strings.(한참 동안 적을 피해 거친 물보라를 헤치고 나서야 드디어 확인하지 못한: (After a long struggle dodging enemies and forcing their way through violent spray, they finally reach the last unexplored corner.)
Pandora, I think this is the only place left... But there's nothing here.
...There's a hidden wall. I can sense Levi behind it...
strings.(판도라가 손을 뻗자 조금 전까지 보이지 않던 벽이 모습을 드러낸다. 벽: (Pandora extends her hand. An invisible wall appears, then collapses the moment it is revealed.)
strings.레비가, 레비가…. 여기에 있어야 하는데…. 왜 네가 있는 거지?: Levi... Levi should be here... Why are you here instead?
strings.저는 괜찮습니다만, 저분…. 저분의 이름이 판도라였습니까?: I'm fine, but that woman... Is her name Pandora?
strings.들어본 적이 있습니다. 외딴 저택에 지내면서 소원을 미끼로 사람들을 죽인: I've heard of her. A witch who lived in a remote mansion, luring people with wishes and killing them...
strings.지금 여기는 어디입니까? 폐하께서 언젠가 말씀하신 마녀들의 싸움이 있다고: Where are we? His Majesty once spoke of a conflict between witches... Why are you using me in that fight?
strings.폐하란 자부터 알아서는 안 될 걸 알고 있군. 그래서 다프네가 널 이곳으: Your emperor knows things he shouldn't. Perhaps that's why Daphne brought you here...
strings.그래서 엘리아스의 레비 님을 찾으셨습니까?: Have you found Levi of Elias, then?
strings.(갑자기 %s의 앞으로 날카롭고 세찬 물보라가 일어나 테이션을 묶더니 그: (A sharp, powerful spray erupts before %s, binds Tation, and lifts him into the air.)
I don't usually repeat an invitation, but I'll offer one more time.
Come to me. Let us welcome the night together.
I'll cooperate only until Levi's soul is whole...
Pandora? What are you saying? Why would you suddenly cooperate with Daphne?
%s, do you trust me? The words of an Agasura and a witch...? I...
strings.(판도라가 말을 다 끝내기도 전에 어디선가 기계 장치 같은 것이 불규칙한: (Before Pandora can finish, the uneven grinding of a mechanism sounds from somewhere.)
strings.(아틀라스 정원에 맴돌고 있는 물방울을 가르며 새도 인간도 기계도 아닌: (Cutting through the water droplets drifting around the Atlas Garden, a being neither bird, human, nor machine flies before them.)
strings.(아름다운 은회색 빛의 몸을 날카롭고 뾰족한 가시로 채운 기괴한 존재가: (The bizarre creature, its beautiful silver-gray body covered in sharp spikes, looks around.)
strings.(아무런 표정도 없는 신의 피조물이 손을 뻗자 방금까지도 없었던 날카로운: (The expressionless creation of the gods reaches out, forming a fan edged with sharp blades where none existed before.)
strings.「▒계의 ▒리와… 영▒을 탐▒는 자여.」: 「You who cov▒t the wo▒ld's tr▒th... and s▒uls.」
(Metheus's voice, mixed with grotesque noise, echoes through the Atlas Garden.)
S-such power... I can barely stand.
strings.「▒을 ▒신해 너희를 심▒하겠다. ▒틀▒스 정▒의 ▒리를 열지 ▒하도록…: 「In the g▒ds' st▒ad, I shall j▒dge you. So you may n▒t unl▒ck the tr▒th of the Atl▒s Garden...」
strings.(메테우스가 부채를 휘두르자 %s의 옆으로 날카로운 바람이 스쳐 지나간다: (Metheus swings its fan, and a razor wind whistles past %s.)
strings.(바람이 닿은 정원의 구조물이 파괴되고 그대로 아래로 떨어진다. 구조물이: (The wind destroys the garden's structures, sending them plummeting below. Each impact in the river raises a vast waterspout that reaches the garden.)
strings.세계의 진리와 영혼을 탐하는 자여, 신을 대신해 너희를 시험하겠다. 아틀: "You who covet the world's truth and souls. I shall test you in the gods' stead, so you cannot unlock the truth of the Atlas Garden..."
A manufactured being dares speak of passing judgment...
strings.(메테우스가 두 사람을 보며 부채를 활짝 펼친다.): (Metheus looks at the pair and spreads its fan wide.)
I trusted you... That's how I came this far.
strings.(%s의 대답이 애매했지만, 그래도 판도라는 만족했는지 작은 미소를 보인: (Though %s's answer is uncertain, Pandora seems satisfied and smiles faintly.)
Understood. Then for now, let's defeat the gardener together.
If the garden is destroyed, it could fall onto the village. It's dangerous.
You really are different from me. In any case, after that, we'll deal with Daphne...
She's already disappeared with Levi... no, Tation. She's going to watch.
I really dislike her. But I suppose that's how she's survived.
strings.나도 그대를 믿고 뭔가 할 거야. 그러니까 끝까지 믿어줬으면 해…. 조금: I'm going to trust you and do something too. So please keep trusting me to the end... Even if some of it doesn't make sense...
strings.(판도라의 시선이 메테우스에게 향하는 순간, 메테우스의 발밑에서 보라색으: (The moment Pandora turns her gaze to Metheus, a violet magic circle spreads beneath its feet.)
As you trust Iris... As I cherish Levi...
strings.(그 순간, 메테우스의 칼날 부채에서 날카로운 소용돌이가 일어나 판도라와: (A razor-sharp whirlwind bursts from Metheus's bladed fan and rushes toward Pandora and %s.)
strings.(메테우스의 공격으로 파괴된 정원의 잔해가 강으로 떨어지지 않도록 판도라: (Pandora keeps casting magic circles around the garden to stop the debris destroyed by Metheus from falling into the river.)
strings.(메테우스가 크게 회전해 다시 커다란 바람을 일으키려고 준비한다. 그때,: (Metheus spins, preparing another immense gale. Seizing the opening, %s strikes its bladed fan.)
strings.(둘의 강력한 힘이 부딪치는 순간, 강에서 커다란 물줄기가 역류하듯 솟아: (The instant their powerful forces collide, an enormous column of water surges upward from the river and engulfs the garden.)
strings.(판도라가 서둘러 정원의 잔해를 비어있는 장소로 던져버린다. 그리고 정원: (Pandora hastily flings the garden's debris into an empty area, then flies toward %s, who slips and loses balance in the crashing waves.)
strings.(판도라가 빠른 속도로 %s의 손을 낚아채 허공으로 오르자 방금까지도 요: (Pandora snatches %s's hand and rises into the air. The churning water below falls still.)
Metheus has stopped moving... Let's take a look...
strings.(판도라가 허공에서 메테우스를 내려다보더니 모험가와 함께 내려온다.): (Pandora peers down at Metheus, then descends with the adventurer.)
(The fallen Metheus does not move as they approach. It seems to be waiting, as though it has something to say.)
I know a divine creation guarding this garden wouldn't stop over so little. Say what you want to say.
strings.「…이곳의 진리를 탐하던 자가 없다는 걸 알게 됐다.」: 「...I have realized that none here covets this place's truth.」
So there is no truth left here.
「...I have realized this is no longer the world of gods I knew... Servants of the gods, I judged wrongly. The truth of this place is...」
strings.(뭔가 말하려던 메테우스의 팔다리와 날개가 어떤 힘으로 꺾여버린다. 그: (Before Metheus can finish, an unseen force bends its limbs and wings. It falls motionless from the impact.)
strings.진리의 행방을 알고 있는 자가 바로 그대로군. 다. 프. 네!!!!: So you're the one who knows where the truth went. DAPHNE!!!!
strings.(판도라의 외침과 함께 %s의 뒤에서 마법진이 생성되고, 그 안에서 강력: (At Pandora's shout, a magic circle forms behind %s, erupting with tremendous magical power.)
strings.(잠시 후, 두 사람 앞에 천천히 다프네의 모습이 드러난다.): (A moment later, Daphne slowly appears before them.)
strings.(모험가가 다가오는 다프네를 향해 무기를 들지만, 다프네의 지팡이가 먼저: (The adventurer raises their weapon at the approaching Daphne, but her staff taps their shoulder first.)
strings.(다프네의 한 마디와 함께 벗어나려던 %s의 움직임이 멈춘다.): (At Daphne's single word, %s's attempt to escape comes to a halt.)
strings.모든 게 멈춰버릴 줄 알았지만, 용케도 정신만이 살아있다니…. 메디아 그: I thought everything would stop, but your mind is still awake... To think Medea would keep you alive even now.
strings.지금 판도라는 당신을 구해줄 수 없어요. 당신의 존재를 잠깐 이면에 가뒀: Pandora cannot save you. I've confined your existence to the Reverse Side for a moment.
strings.당신이 아무것도 할 수 없던 것처럼 판도라도 아무것도 할 수 없단 걸 잘: She knows full well that she can do nothing, just as you could do nothing. Hehe.
strings.다프네…, 얼마나 많은 마녀를 죽였기에 이런 능력까지 갖추고 있는 거지?: Daphne... How many witches have you killed to gain powers like these?
strings.자, 판도라. 아직도 결정하지 못하고 있는 거 같으니까 살짝 도움을 드리: Now, Pandora. Since you still seem unable to decide, I'll offer a little help.
strings.(다프네의 미소와 함께 어디선가 익숙한 목소리가 들려온다.): (As Daphne smiles, a familiar voice sounds from somewhere.)
Yes, Pandora. I can see you've made up your mind. State your conditions.
Make a contract with me that you will never harm Levi.
A contract with an Agasura... But the terms would be rather unusual.
strings.소원으로 얻는 게 나라면 대가로 그대의 목숨을 걸어. 레비에게 손댄다면: If I am what your wish gains you, stake your life as payment. Include the condition that if you touch Levi, you may be put to death.
And I will remain with you only until Levi's soul is whole.
Hehe. Quite a few unexpected conditions, but a fair bargain.
strings.(다프네가 흡족한 미소를 지으면서 지팡이로 바닥을 두드린다. 잠시 후,: (Smiling in satisfaction, Daphne taps the ground with her staff. An enormous droplet rises and bursts, dropping Tation onto the ground.)
strings.(판도라가 아가슈라의 술식으로 보이는 마법진을 만든다. 그리고 손에 상처: (Pandora forms a magic circle that appears to use an Agasura's ritual. She cuts her hand and lets her blood fall into it.)
(Daphne approaches, watching the blood-fed magic circle glow hot.)
strings.판도라, 하나만 물을게요. 아가슈라의 계약은 절대적이죠?: Pandora, one question. An Agasura's contract is absolute, isn't it?
It is like a transcendent being's curse. No god of Etoile can ever tamper with it...
strings.(순간 다프네의 표정이 바뀐다. 놀란 판도라가 다프네를 붙잡으려고 하지만: (Daphne's expression changes. Alarmed, Pandora reaches for her, but Daphne has already appeared behind Tation.)
strings.(그 말과 함께 테이션의 복부에서 다프네의 지팡이에서 자란 굵은 가지들이: (At those words, thick branches growing from Daphne's staff burst through Tation's abdomen. Moments later, he falls beneath the garden along with the severed branches.)
strings.(핏빛으로 붉게 변한 마법진 속에서 피가 솟아올라 판도라의 얼굴에 떨어진: (Blood surges from the magic circle, now crimson, and splashes onto Pandora's face.)
strings.(판도라!! 판도라!! 대체 어떻게 된 거야? 여기서 나가야 해!!): (Pandora!! Pandora!! What's happening? I have to get out of here!!)
strings.(다프네가 괴로워하는 판도라와 %s의 모습을 번갈아 바라본다.): (Daphne looks between the suffering Pandora and %s.)
Pandora, an Agasura's contract is absolute. What you're experiencing now is proof...
No. I can't return to a beast's form here...
strings.(다프네가 지팡이로 판도라의 어깨를 두드린다. 잠시 후, 괴로워하며 비명: (Daphne taps Pandora's shoulder with her staff. A moment later, Pandora's agonized screams cease, and she slumps to the ground.)
strings.이걸로 당신은 저와 함께 갈 수 있게 됐어요. 그리고 %s, 이제 끝났으: Now you can come with me. And %s, it's over. You may return.
strings.(다프네!! 대체 판도라에게 무슨 짓을 한 거야? 으, 어….): (Daphne!! What did you do to Pandora? Ugh... Huh...)
strings.모, 몸이 움직여. 파, 판도라 님 괜찮아요?: I-I can move. P-Pandora, are you all right?
strings.(판도라가 다시 나타난 %s의 얼굴을 보더니 슬픈 표정을 짓는다.): (Pandora looks sadly at %s, who has reappeared.)
I'm sorry. You trusted me, and I made a mistake...
Pandora will be coming with me now.
strings.그게 무슨 말도 안 되는 소리야?!: What nonsense are you talking about?!
strings.수명을 담보 삼아 도박하는 건 아가슈라의 특징인가보군요. 후후. 그 짧은: Gambling with one's lifespan must be an Agasura trait. Hehe. To add another clause in so little time...
strings.판도라 자신이 레비와 같은 색의 영혼을 가진 자를 손댈 경우, 계약으로: If Pandora herself harmed someone whose soul shared Levi's color, she wanted the witch bound by the contract to die as well...
strings.판도라는 스스로 계약하면서 레비의 영혼이 온전해질 때까지 저와 함께하겠다: In binding herself to the contract, Pandora stipulated that she would remain with me until Levi's soul became whole.
strings.그래서 제가 계약 내용을 다시 확인한 거예요. 아가슈라의 계약은 절대적이: That's why I confirmed the terms. An Agasura's contract is absolute. So for now, I'll leave Levi as he is. That way, Pandora cannot leave me...
strings.그런 말도 안 되는 일이 신에게도 일어나는데, 아가슈라에게 일어나지 말란: Such impossible things happen even to gods. There's no reason they couldn't happen to an Agasura.
strings.판도라…. 테이션의 영혼은 내가 아는 안전한 곳으로 보냈어요. 이게 무슨: Pandora... I've sent Tation's soul to a safe place I know. Do you understand what that means?
Levi could meet his death at any moment, with his soul still incomplete.
strings.조용히 절 따라오세요. 그게 당신과 레비가 살 수 있는 유일한 방법이니까: Follow me quietly. It's the only way you and Levi can live.
strings.그나저나 레비의 음성을 적당히 만들었을 뿐인데, 그걸 속다니. 판도라,: And to think, I only cobbled together an imitation of Levi's voice, yet you fell for it. Pandora, you really are...
Oh, the real Levi is coming just now.
strings.(다프네가 가리키는 곳에서 여행자 복장의 진짜 레비가 빠른 속도로 이곳을: (Where Daphne points, the real Levi, dressed for travel, runs swiftly toward them.)
strings.(레비가 쥔 비론타의 창이 다프네의 목에 닿으려고 하는 순간, 다프네가: (As the tip of Levi's Bironta spear nears Daphne's throat, she lowers her head and smiles softly.)
strings.(커다란 소리와 함께 레비가 그 자리에서 쓰러진다. %s도 마찬가지로 강: (A tremendous sound rings out, and Levi falls where he stands. %s is likewise driven backward by a powerful impact.)
Where is Lady Pandora? Where did that witch...?
strings.(레비가 멍한 눈동자로 주위를 둘러보지만, 그의 앞에는 아무것도 없다.): (Levi looks around blankly, but there is nothing before him.)
Yes. Some of Daphne's powers were taken from witches she killed...
I understand. We must find Lady Pandora quickly...
strings.(레비가 발걸음을 멈추고 한쪽으로 바라본다.): (Levi stops and looks to one side.)
strings.(불규칙한 느낌으로 돌아가는 기계 장치 소리가 들린다.): (The uneven grinding of machinery can be heard.)
strings.(쓰러져 있던 메테우스의 팔과 다리, 날개가 알 수 없는 과정으로 뒤틀리: (The fallen Metheus's arms, legs, and wings twist through some unknown process, then return to their original shapes.)
strings.일반적인 괴물은 아니군요. %s 님, 저걸 어떻게 상대해야 합니까?: This is no ordinary monster. %s, how should we fight it?
strings.「정원에 있는 자들은 들어라…. 마녀는 사라졌다.」: 「All within the garden, listen... The witches have gone.」
strings.「마녀는 너희들에게서 기억을 지우고 사라졌다….」: 「The witch erased your memories before leaving...」
strings.그럴 거라고 짐작은 했어. 그런데 넌 어떻게 그걸 기억하고 있지?: I suspected as much. But how do you remember?
strings.「난 위대한 벽에서 신들이 창조한 존재……. 별이 품고 있는 기억을 빌렸: 「I was created by the gods at the Great Wall... I merely borrowed the memories held by the star...」
strings.「그리고 지금의 의식을 지닌 난 더는 싸우지 않는다.」: 「And with my present awareness, I will fight no more.」
strings.(메테우스가 자리에서 일어나 멍하니 하늘을 바라본다.): (Metheus rises and gazes blankly at the sky.)
strings.「신들이 둘로 나뉘어 싸웠던 것도, 살아있는 자들이 싸우는 이유도 어떻게: 「The gods split into two sides and fought. The living fight as well. Perhaps their reasons are not so different...」
strings.「존재하는 자들은 자신을 증명해야 하니까 …. 」: 「For all who exist must prove themselves...」
strings.「나는 더는 지킬 것이 없다. 지킬 것이 없으니 존재할 의미도 없다.」: 「I have nothing left to protect. With nothing to protect, my existence has no meaning.」
strings.「어리석은 진리조차 사라진 세계에선….」: 「In a world where even that foolish truth is gone...」
strings.「신을 따르는 자여. 검은 달이 세계의 진리가 되길 바라는가?」: 「Servants of the gods. Do you wish the black moon to become the world's truth?」
strings.「정원은 앞으로 이곳에 남아 아래를 바라볼 것이다. 이곳을 다시 찾는다면: 「The garden will remain here, looking down upon the world. If you return, be prepared to destroy this body as you did today.」
strings.「세계를 사랑하지 않는 자의 뜻대로 움직이고 싶지 않다면….」: 「Unless you wish to act according to the will of one who does not love the world...」
strings.(메테우스가 말을 마치고 천천히 하늘로 떠오른다.): (Finishing its words, Metheus slowly rises into the sky.)
W-wait! Don't go yet. I have a question...
strings.(떠오르던 메테우스가 %s의 얼굴을 내려다본다.): (Metheus looks down at %s as it ascends.)
strings.「내가 알고 있는 것만 답하겠다.」: 「I will answer only what I know.」
strings.정원은 왜 사라졌다 다시 나타난 거지?: Why did the garden vanish and then return?
strings.(메테우스가 입을 여는 순간, 레비가 고통스러워한다.): (The moment Metheus speaks, Levi doubles over in pain.)
strings.(그말을 끝으로 메테우스가 뒤도 돌아보지 않고 하늘로 날아올라 모습을 감: (With those final words, Metheus flies into the sky without looking back and disappears.)
You can't hear the gods' language without permission.
The gods' language... Then that creature is...
A creation of the gods, made to guard the truth of this place... And...
strings.(레비에게 이리스의 부탁을 받아 라란 가도에 왔고, 판도라를 만났던 일을: (I tell Levi everything: Iris's request, my arrival at Laran Road, and my meeting with Pandora.)
Lady Pandora did it for me... But even so, such a choice...
strings.(이야기를 전부 들은 레비가 고개를 푹 숙인다.): (After hearing the full story, Levi bows his head.)
strings.그런데, 레비는 어떻게 이곳에 올 수 있었던 거죠? 여기는 신과 관련있는: But how did you get here, Levi? I was told only those connected to the gods could enter...
strings.(레비가 %s의 질문에 품 안에서 새하얀 깃털 하나를 꺼낸다.): (In answer to %s's question, Levi takes a pure white feather from his clothing.)
strings.다프네라는 마녀가 판도라 님을 죽이려 한다고 절 속여 에기르 유적의 이면: The witch Daphne tricked me by saying she intended to kill Lady Pandora. Then she trapped me on the Reverse Side of the Aegir Ruins.
strings.천사님께서 어떻게 아셨는지 절 찾아서 바로 꺼내주셨죠…. %s 님께서 찾: Somehow, the angel found me and freed me... She asked whether I was the Levi you were searching for, %s...
Then she gave me this and told me to go to the garden.
%s... I-I can sense Lady Pandora's magic nearby.
strings.(레비가 고개를 들어 주위를 이리저리 둘러본다.): (Levi raises his head and looks around.)
strings.(레비가 말을 마치자마자 올라왔던 방향으로 서둘러 뛰어간다.): (No sooner has he spoken than Levi runs back the way they came.)
strings.레비가 판도라의 마력과 이어져 있다고 하니까 맞는 것 같은데…: He said he's connected to Pandora's magic, so he's probably right...
I don't know... Let's go. Maybe we'll learn something there.
strings.(레비를 따라 정원을 맴돌고 있던 물방울들을 헤치고 나아가자, 라란 가도: (Following Levi through the droplets circling the garden, the adventurer draws closer to Laran Road.)
strings.(그리고 처음 정원으로 들어갔던 장소에 도착한다.): (They arrive at the place where they first entered the garden.)
The enormous droplet we used to enter is still here.
strings.(한곳을 응시하고 있던 레비의 옆으로 정원에서 사라졌던 판도라가 모습을: (As Levi stares at one spot, Pandora, who vanished from the garden, appears beside him.)
strings.판도라 님, 괜찮으십니까?: Lady Pandora, are you all right?
Even now, you worry about me, Levi...
I'm sorry I came too late...
No. I'm the one who's sorry...
I'm sorry to both you and %s.
I made the wrong choice and opened something that should never have been opened.
I should never have gone to the garden...
Still, I'm glad I can say goodbye before leaving...
I know what you want to say. An Agasura's contract is binding... There's no way around it.
strings.(쓸쓸한 눈빛을 감추지 못한 판도라가 조용히 레비의 손을 끌어당긴다. 레: (Unable to hide the sorrow in her eyes, Pandora quietly draws Levi's hands toward her. Understanding, he lets her hold them.)
strings.…아가슈라의 계약으로는 방법이 없겠지만, 마녀의 능력이라면 방법이 있을: ...An Agasura's contract may offer no escape, but perhaps a witch's power will.
Until then, I may have no choice but to follow Daphne...
strings.(판도라가 말끝을 흐리며 레비의 두 손을 밀어낸다.): (Pandora's voice trails off as she gently pushes Levi's hands away.)
strings.이제 그만…. 그리고, %s. 테이션의 육체는 다른 곳으로 흘러 갔으니까: That's enough now... And %s, Tation's body drifted elsewhere. You won't find it here. We can only hope it's found later...
Thank you... for trusting me to the end...
Go back to Jiendia at once.
strings.나는 레비가 지엔디아로 돌아갔으면 좋겠어. 그러면 언제가 됐든 기분 좋게: I want you to return to Jiendia, Levi. Then, whenever that day comes, I'll be able to wait happily for you at the mansion.
I haven't given up hope yet...
strings.(판도라가 그대로 등을 돌리자 마치 기다리고 있었던 것처럼 짙은 그림자가: (Pandora turns away. Dense shadows approach as though they have been waiting.)
strings.(레비가 판도라를 향해 손을 뻗지만, 판도라는 어둠 속에 삼켜져 사라져버: (Levi reaches for her, but Pandora has already vanished into the darkness.)
This can't be... We'd only just found each other again...
strings.(레비가 멍하니 판도라가 사라진 자리를 바라본다.): (Levi stares blankly at the spot where Pandora disappeared.)
strings.저는 괜찮습니다. 판도라 님이 걱정이지만…. %s 님, 저 엘리아스로 돌: I'm all right. I'm worried about Lady Pandora, but... %s, I'll return to Elias.
It's my promise to Lady Pandora... You needn't worry about the rest.
Then, %s, please take care of Iris. I'll see you again.
I suppose the result is what Iris asked for, but...
After what happened to Pandora... And what Metheus said still troubles me...
strings.(고개를 들어 보이는 하늘에는 여전히 불길한 분위기를 가득 품은 정원이: (Looking up, the adventurer sees the garden still floating in the sky, filled with an ominous air.)
strings.이 세계는 얼마나 많은 걸 숨기고 있는 걸까…. 후우, 이리스…. 우리는: How much is this world hiding...? Sigh. Iris... How much more will we have to do?
strings.일단 마을에 가봐야겠다…. 정원이 나타난 것만으로도 사람들은 혼란스러울: I'd better return to the village... The garden's appearance alone must have confused everyone...
strings.(연희가 조용히 하늘을 바라보다가 주위를 두리번거린다. 익숙한 사람이 자: (Yeonhee gazes quietly at the sky, then looks around. When a familiar figure seems about to pass her by, she softly calls their name.)
Thanks to your help, I found him quickly.
strings.그게 레비가 바빠서 절 만나고 바로 지엔디아…, 엘리아스 왕국으로 돌아갔: He was busy. After we met, he returned straight to Jiendia... to the Kingdom of Elias.
strings.그동안 마을에는 별일 없었죠?: Has anything happened in the village while I was gone?
strings.(연희 님도 모르는 것 같은데…. 뭔가 알아차렸다면 마을이 조용하진 않았: (She doesn't seem to know either... If anyone had noticed something, the village wouldn't be so quiet...)
Do you mean something like Aie Island...? Oh, I promised. I'm sorry.
Then perhaps you mean those people...
strings.(연희가 바라본 쪽에 마을 사람들로 보이지 않는 자들이 무리를 지어서 서: (Where Yeonhee looks, a group of people who do not appear to be villagers stands gathered.)
They seem to be mages from the Silvaria Empire's Magic Bureau and knights belonging to the council.
strings.(연희가 전혀 모르겠다는 표정을 보인다. 그러다 뭔가 떠올랐는지 환하게: (Yeonhee looks puzzled, then smiles brightly as something occurs to her.)
strings.그건 그렇고, %s 님. 레온이 식사에 초대했는데, 같이 가시겠어요?: Anyway, %s, Leon invited me to dinner. Would you like to join us?
strings.(언제 나타났는지 헬레나가 다가와 %s의 손목을 붙잡는다.): (Helena appears without warning and takes %s by the wrist.)
strings.모험가가 선약이 있거든요. 이 사람과…. 시간을 잊었는지 이제야 나타났군: Our adventurer has a prior engagement with me... Perhaps they forgot the time. They've only just arrived.
strings.%s에겐 시간이 많겠지만, 이 사람에겐 남은 시간이 많지 않아요. 그러니: You may have plenty of time ahead of you, %s, but I don't have much left. You should have come sooner.
strings.아아아, 헬레나 님. 그런 말씀 하시지 마세요. 죄, 죄송합니다. 제가: Oh, Helena, don't say that! I-I'm sorry. I should have come earlier!
strings.(그런데 내가 왜 빨리 왔어야 하는 거지? 아…. 헬레나 님, 일부러 그: (But why should I have come earlier? Oh... She's doing this deliberately...)
strings.%s 님, 어르신을 기다리게 하면 못써요. 후후. 용서해드린다고 하시니: You mustn't keep an elderly lady waiting, %s. Hehe. She's willing to forgive you, so do apologize properly.
Then have a lovely time, %s. I'll see you later.
And I hope you make many happy memories in Luria, young lady.
strings.고맙습니다, 어르신. 이것도 인연인데…, 이거 받아주시겠어요?: Thank you, madam. Since fate has brought us together... Would you accept this?
strings.(연희가 들고온 가방에서 뭔가 꺼내 헬레나에게 보여준다.): (Yeonhee takes something from her bag and shows it to Helena.)
It's a norigae, a traditional hanging ornament from Elias. A skilled artisan made it, and it's beautiful. I thought it would suit you.
strings.오, 귀한 물건이군요. 고마워요, 아가씨. 글래스턴의 공방 거리 장인이: Oh, what a precious gift. Thank you, young lady. Its craftsmanship is every bit as fine as the work of Glaston's artisan quarter.
strings.다음에 이 사람이 아가씨를 초대해도 될까요? 지엔디아와 프레이오스 역사에: May I invite you over another time? I'd like to chat about the history of Jiendia and Freios...
strings.무, 물론이죠! 저도 어르신의 고견을 듣고 싶었습니다. 최고의 고고학자께: O-of course! I've been hoping to hear your insights. A conversation with such a great archaeologist... I'm truly looking forward to it!
strings.후후, 그렇게 봐주니 고맙네요. 그러면 아가씨, 나중에 내가 레온을 보낼: Hehe. Thank you for thinking so highly of me. I'll send Leon for you later. Come by when you have time.
strings.흐음…. 무슨 일이 있긴 있는 건가? 어쩔 수 없지. 내가 뭘 할 수 있: Hmm... So something is happening after all? Oh well. There's nothing I can do about it.
strings.미안해요. 이 사람이 갑자기 나타나서 당황했죠?: I'm sorry. I must have startled you, appearing so suddenly.
(Helena begins speaking over tea that seems to have been prepared in advance.)
strings.아니에요. 그런데 무슨 일로 부르셨어요?: Not at all. But why did you call me over?
That young lady is traveling through Freios with the council's support.
strings.몰랐군요. 마침 의회 소속 기사단과 마법청 마법사들이 와서 당신을 이곳으: So you didn't. The council's knights and the Bureau's mages had just arrived, so I brought you here.
strings.이 사람과 함께 있다면 그래도 이곳에서는 모험가 당신을 건드리진 않을 거: As long as you're with me, they won't touch you here.
strings.껍질뿐인 황족이지만, 이럴 땐 유용하군요. 안 그래도 폐하의 부탁도 있었: I may be imperial royalty in name only, but it has its uses. And Her Majesty did ask a favor of me.
strings.카이나 그 아이는 언제나 그래요. 도통 알아들을 수 없는 말로 편지를 보: Kaina is always like this. She sends letters full of things I can't make sense of.
strings.레비라는 청년이 떠나고 당신이 돌아올 테니 당분간 이 사람에게 부탁한다면: She said that after the young man named Levi left, you would return, and asked me to look after you for a while.
strings.폐하께서 말씀하신 거라면 그렇게 해야겠네요. 함부로 움직였다가는 위험한: If Her Majesty said so, I should listen. Moving carelessly could bring danger...
And Aaron is watching us from over there, so we should be careful.
strings.(순간 아론과 눈이 마주치지만, 무시하고 다시 헬레나와의 대화에 집중한다: (For a moment, the adventurer meets Aaron's eyes, then ignores him and returns their attention to Helena.)
strings.네레이스 관문에서 봤을 땐 작은 일을 하고 있다고 했었는데, 실상은 의장: When I met him at Nereis Gateway, he said he handled minor matters. In fact, he was the council chairman...
strings.아론을 만났었군요. 뱀 같은 사람인데…. 하여튼 이게 중요한 게 아니고…: So you've met Aaron. A snake of a man... But that isn't what matters now...
strings.잠깐 제 집에서 머물면서 상황을 지켜보세요. 폐하께서 부탁하셨으니 조만간: Stay at my house for a while and watch how things develop. Since Her Majesty asked me to do this, you should hear from her soon.
strings.때가 되면 저 하늘의 유적을 설명해 주겠나요? 내 눈에만 보이는 것 같은: When the time is right, will you explain those ruins in the sky? I seem to be the only one who can see them...
